jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and validation of the enterprise data architecture for DCIPS Future, a Department of War (DoW) modernization program supporting Casualty and Mortuary Affairs operations across the Military Services. The Senior Data Architect will maintain secure, reliable, and scalable data architectures within AWS GovCloud environments authorized for applicable Impact Levels, including IL2, IL4, and IL5. The architect will work with mission stakeholders, system architects, cybersecurity personnel, database administrators, developers, and testers to ensure data integrity, availability, privacy, and accurate inter-Service data exchange.

This position is remote within the United States. Periodic travel may be required.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Data Architect will:

  • Perform an initial architecture assessment and develop a recovery plan that inventories existing artifacts, identifies gaps and risks, establishes an authoritative baseline, and prioritizes corrective actions.

  • Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

  • Define schemas, entity relationships, business rules, data standards, and validation requirements.

  • Maintain data dictionaries, metadata, lineage records, source-to-target mappings, and data-flow diagrams.

  • Ensure alignment among mission workflows, application functions, databases, APIs, interfaces, and reporting requirements.

  • Establish data-architecture governance, including modeling standards, architecture decisions, schema versioning, and change control.

  • Lead data-migration planning, including profiling, cleansing, transformation, mock migrations, reconciliation, cutover, and post-conversion validation.

  • Design for 99.99% availability, rapid failover, scalability, backup, and recovery.

  • Incorporate privacy and security requirements, including data minimization, access controls, encryption, masking, auditability, and retention.

  • Define secure API and data-exchange patterns for Military Service components and external systems.

  • Lead or support required architecture, database, reporting, and data-migration deliverables.

  • Manage and provide mentorship to a team of database administrators, data engineers, and developers.

  • Present architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to contractor and government stakeholders.

Qualifications

Clearance

  • Active Secret security clearance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • At least seven years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or data engineering.

  • Experience leading data architecture for a complex, mission-critical system.

  • Federal or DoW experience strongly preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and AWS services such as Amazon RDS or Aurora.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or another regulated cloud environment.

  • Knowledge of schema design, normalization, indexing, metadata management, data lineage, and data-quality controls.

  • Experience planning and validating complex legacy-data migrations.

  • Experience designing highly available database solutions with replication, backup, recovery, and failover capabilities.

  • Knowledge of DoWAF, the DoW Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide, applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Experience protecting personally identifiable information and other sensitive government data.

  • Experience with API-based data exchange, reporting, analytics, and business-intelligence systems.

Preferred Certifications and Experience

  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or another current and relevant AWS certification.

  • TOGAF certification or formal DoDAF training.

  • Applicable DoW 8140 qualification for the assigned DoW Cyberspace Workforce Framework work role.

  • Experience supporting Casualty and Mortuary Affairs operations, personnel, case-management, or similarly sensitive mission systems.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and architectural decision-making skills.

  • Exceptional attention to data quality and model integrity.

  • Ability to produce clear and concise technical documentation.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to take ownership, resolve inherited issues, and drive architecture decisions to completion.

  • Work remotely while traveling up to 70% of the time in CA, including overnight stays
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with team members and customers
  • Complete training documentation, implementation reports, and follow-up communications in a timely and professional manner
  • Communicate customer feedback, CA market trends, and emerging needs related to dual language education, biliteracy, multilingual learners, and ELD to internal stakeholders
  • Identify customer needs and recommend additional print, digital, assessment, and professional learning solutions that support dual language and bilingual program success
  • Adhere to organizational expectations, procedures, and professional standards while actively participating in ongoing training and professional growth opportunities.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Education
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in K-12 education
  • Teaching experience in one or of the following: Comprehensive Literacy, Science of Reading Research, Intervention Work, English Language Learner Support
  • Experience with technology in education and adult learning practices
  • Familiarity with CA state standards and CA literacy initiatives
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Zoom, TEAMS, and online tools (Google Classroom a plus)
  • Superior communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to present to large audiences and key decision-making stakeholders in sales situations

  • Travel required and can be up to 70%, including overnight stays

Benchmark Education Company (BEC) is a leading publisher of core, supplemental, and intervention literacy and language resources in English and Spanish, with valid and reliable digital assessments that inform instruction. BEC is also a provider of exceptional professional development to educators.

BEC is recognized as a responsive publisher that offers equally rigorous and engaging digital, print, and hybrid learning materials grounded in the Science of Reading research. Family owned and operated for more than 25 years, BEC is committed to partnering with educators to provide the best for all students through resources of exceptional quality, world-class professional learning, and effective and dedicated customer support.

Every home search starts with one question: is the right home here? Inventory is the foundation of everything Redfin builds. The more complete, accurate, and distinctive our listings are, the more often people start with us, stay longer, and come back. As part of Rocket Companies, Redfin now has a growing set of homes that buyers can only find on Redfin. Turning that advantage into the best home-search experience on the market is one of our biggest opportunities, and you will own it.


You will lead two connected efforts: growing the supply of homes on Redfin, and building experiences that make that supply stand out and bring buyers back. The scope of this role will grow as the opportunity does, and we want someone who can find the biggest problems, define them clearly, and move quickly.


This is a role for a hands-on AI builder. You will prototype with tools like Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor, size opportunities by querying your own data, and find places where AI can improve how we source, enrich, and present inventory.

About the role

  • Define the strategy and roadmap for growing the volume, quality, and freshness of listings on Redfin, including new sources of supply, data partnerships, and ingestion improvements.
  • Shape how Redfin-exclusive inventory reaches buyers and sellers across search, listing detail pages, alerts, and re-engagement surfaces on web and apps, so buyers have a reason to search on Redfin first.
  • Find the places where AI can improve how we source, enrich, and present listings, and partner with engineering and data science to ship them with sound evaluation and quality tradeoffs.
  • Prototype with tools like Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor, and bring working concepts to engineering instead of static specs.
  • Own a defined set of inventory and engagement metrics, run experiments that answer real questions, and use results to guide rollouts.
  • Partner with engineering, design, data science, brokerage operations, and teams across Rocket, and keep leadership aligned on strategy, tradeoffs, results, and next steps.

About you

  • 5+ years of product management experience delivering consumer web and mobile products at scale, with shipped work that moved key metrics.
  • Experience with marketplace, supply-side, or inventory-driven products, and a clear view of how supply quality shapes customer experience.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You use tools like Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor to prototype, analyze data, and write specs, and you can show us something you built. We will ask you to walk us through it: the problem you chose, how you built it, and what you learned.
  • Strong data skills, including SQL (by hand or with an LLM) to investigate performance and size opportunities.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can define a problem, decide with incomplete information, and adjust as you learn.
  • A record of aligning engineering, design, operations, and business leaders around a shared plan.
  • Experience in real estate, listings, or another high-consideration marketplace.
  • Experience shipping LLM-powered features to production, including evaluation and quality tradeoffs.
  • Experience with listing data, MLS or data partnerships, or content ingestion pipelines.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.


About us

Redfin is a technology-driven real estate company with the country's most-visited real estate brokerage website. As part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), Redfin is creating an integrated homeownership platform from search to close to make the dream of homeownership more affordable and accessible for everyone. Redfin’s clients can see homes first with on-demand tours, easily apply for a home loan with Rocket Mortgage, and save thousands in fees while working with a top local agent.

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery.

Our Business Development teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative.

Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our GBS Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue.

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

  • Experience leading teams responsible for sales analytics, performance management, reporting, or sales planning.
  • Advanced experience using Power BI and Excel to create dashboards, automate reporting, and translate data into decision-ready insights.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled sales capabilities, including practical use of AI features, digital assistants, or bots within CRM and sales workflows.
  • Proven ability to translate complex enterprise, customer, producer, market, and competitive information into focused sales strategies and actions.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in financial services, insurance, wealth management, or a similarly regulated and distribution-intensive industry.
  • Experience in insurance business lines, specifically annuities, life insurance, executive benefits and disability insurance
  • Experience partnering with enterprise data and technology teams on data models, integrations, governance, and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Knowledge of both proprietary and third-party distribution models.

Overview

DecisionPoint is seeking a skilled Mid-Level Security Automation Engineer to join our Cloud Services (CS) team. In this role, you will help maintain and enhance the ARTRANS AWS cloud environments and DevSecOps platform.

You will implement and manage security controls for ARTRANS DevSecOps pipelines and AWS GovCloud accounts, ensuring compliance with NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 through the Risk Management Framework (RMF). Additionally, you will integrate RMF requirements and associated security controls into the DevSecOps pipeline to enable continuous security and compliance across Programs of Record.

This position is fully remote and requires an active Secret clearance.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize AWS GovCloud infrastructure using Terraform.

  • Identify and remediate findings in AWS Security Hub.

  • Develop solutions for RMF risk assessments and create Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Embed security controls within Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration as Code (CaC) processes.
  • Recommend effective courses of action for risk mitigation.
  • Assess and recommend tools and platform features to support compliance with Zero Trust architecture and RMF security requirements.
  • Detect and remediate configuration drift in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes, and AWS environments.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance is required.
  • Associate degree with at least 6 years of related experience, or 8 years of continuous related work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Possess a DCWF 8140, IAT Level II certification, such as Security+ CE.
  • Strong understanding of AWS GovCloud environments
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Terraform, Helm, YAML, and Kubernetes

The Pricing Manager will play a critical role in transforming pricing into a strategic capability by leveraging data, market insights, customer value drivers, and advanced analytics to optimize pricing decisions.   • Perform deal-level financial analysis, price realization assessments, profitability modeling, and scenario evaluations to support pricing decisions for enterprise, multi-product, and long-term customer agreements
  • Monitor market conditions, competitive pricing trends, and customer willingness to pay to inform pricing decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Management on new product pricing, portfolio optimization, and value proposition development.
  • Champion a data-driven pricing culture across the organization through training, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Develop and maintain financial models, ROI calculators, total cost of ownership (TCO) tools, and value communication frameworks that enable commercial teams to articulate and capture the value delivered by Repligen's products and solutions.
  • Monitor pricing performance, value capture effectiveness, and customer response to pricing initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve pricing architecture, reduce price dispersion, strengthen pricing discipline, and increase realization of the value delivered to customers

Technical & Analytics Skills

The candidate should be able to demonstrate experience with:

  • Value-Based Pricing methodologies
  • New Product Pricing
  • Portfolio Pricing Strategy
  • Customer Segmentation
  • Willingness-to-Pay Analysis
  • Competitive Pricing Intelligence
  • Pricing Architecture Design
  • Contract Pricing and Revenue Management
  • Price Increase Management
  • Discount and Rebate Management

In this role, you will help identify opportunities for continuous improvement, deliver value to internal and external customers, ensure operational excellence, manage and contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and lead a team in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. You will work across the HealthEdge enterprise to drive adoption of Problem Management practices, facilitate collaboration among stakeholders, and promote accountability for corrective actions that improve platform stability and customer experience. Strong communication and partnership skills are essential, as this role serves as a key connection point between Engineering, Operations, Product, and other stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly manage the problem team, including the Data Operations Manager and Problem Analyst, providing clear direction, regular 1:1 coaching, performance feedback and career development support for each team member.
  • Set individual and team goals aligned to REO’s operational objectives; conduct performance reviews and advocate for your team’s growth and recognition within the broader REO organization.
  • Identify skill gaps and development opportunities within the pod – supporting certifications (ITIL, data engineering, SRE fundamentals), cross-training and stretch assignments that build long-term capability.
  • Foster a team culture grounded in blameless learning, data discipline and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in hiring decisions for the team – writing and refining job descriptions, conducting structured interviews and onboarding new team members effectively utilizing a defined orientation plan.
  • Proactively manage team capacity and workload distribution across the team members, ensuring no single individual is a single point of failure for a critical deliverable.

Post-Incident Leadership & Practice Ownership

  • Own executive accountability for the post-incident lifecycle across all Severity 1 and Severity 2 events affecting HealthEdge’s client-facing platform – continuously maintaining oversight and quality standards.
  • Lead post-mortems for the highest-severity events and those defined within cross-organizational scope
  • Ensure weekly outage review cadence runs with consistency and rigor – reviewing agendas, monitoring action item completion rates and holding team members accountable to delivery timelines.
  • Serve as the escalation point when post-mortem corrective actions are blocked, deprioritized or at risk of aging out without resolution – engaging Engineering leadership or other stakeholders directly when needed.
  • Maintain visibility into the full Problem Record backlog and Known Error database – understanding the top open known errors by product line, business impact and age at all times.

Problem Framework Strategy & Governance

  • Own the Problem Management framework at the strategic level – creating the framework, defining the vision for how the practice matures, setting quality standards and ensuring the framework remains fit for purpose as the organization scales.
  • Drive adoption of the Problem Management framework across HealthEdge business units – building relationships with Operations, Engineering Managers, SRE leads and Product stakeholders who need to understand and participate in the process.
  • Ensure the Problem framework integrates effectively with Incident Management and Change Management – partnering with peer leads in REO to close process gaps at the seams between disciplines.
  • Champion the use of AI and operational intelligence outputs – produced by the Data Operations Manager, who resides on the problem team – as inputs to Problem prioritization, engineering roadmap planning and executive reporting.
  • Represent Problem Management in cross-functional governance forums and ITSM working groups, ensuring the teams priorities are visible and influential in organizational planning.

Operational Intelligence Oversight

  • Provide strategic direction to the Data Operations Manager on which data sources, failure patterns and toil categories represent the highest business value for analytical investment.
  • Review and sponsor executive-facing dashboards and trend reports produced by the team, ensuring accuracy, narrative clarity and appropriate framing for all audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the teams data capabilities – new integrations, AI-assisted workflows or reporting automation – and build the business case for tooling or headcount investment where warranted.

Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Reporting

The position is expected to perform high level complex investigations of medical professional service providers and develop cases for future action, including referral to law enforcement, education, over payment recovery and other administrative actions.   • As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.
  • There may be times when investigators need to react to unplanned situations, be flexible in planning their activities and adopt effective courses of action.

Solutions Engineer - DBA

Position Summary

The Solutions Engineer - DBA is responsible for the reliable, secure, and highly available operation of Midland’s enterprise database and data integration platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. The role supports Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), ETL, SFTP, workload automation, and end-to-end data flows. Using a DevOps for Data approach, the position automates deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery while supporting high availability, disaster recovery, performance optimization, cloud integration, data governance, and emerging AI-enabled database technologies.

Primary Accountabilities

Job Specific

  • Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database across on-premises, Microsoft Azure, and OCI environments, including Oracle Autonomous Database and related cloud database services.
  • Support SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Windows Server Failover Clustering, cross-site replication, high availability, disaster recovery, failover/failback, and recovery testing.
  • Perform database performance tuning, backup and recovery, patching, upgrades, migrations, indexing, security administration, capacity management, and database connectivity support.
  • Monitor database health, availability, logs, performance metrics, wait events, blocking, storage, capacity, and alerts using Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM), AWR/ASH, SQL Server monitoring tools, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and similar observability platforms.
  • Manage database secrets, credentials, encryption keys, wallets, and SSL/TLS certificates using technologies such as Azure Key Vault, OCI Vault, Oracle Wallet, and TDE key management, including secure storage, access control, expiration monitoring, and rotation.
  • Apply DevOps and CI/CD practices to database administration using source control, automated deployment pipelines, database scripts, configuration-as-code, testing, approvals, rollback, and repeatable change processes.
  • Develop and maintain SQL, PowerShell, Python, Linux shell, API, and other automation supporting database administration, operational processes, job scheduling, workload automation, monitoring, alerting, and failure recovery.
  • Support Windows Server infrastructure associated with SQL Server, including Failover Clustering, networking, DNS, SAN storage, and related components, and support Linux administration associated with enterprise Oracle environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues spanning databases, operating systems, storage, networks, applications, monitoring platforms, and cloud services; partner with Application and Data Engineering teams and vendors on cross-functional resolution.
  • Support ETL, data integration, enterprise data movement, SFTP/managed file transfer, APIs, scheduling platforms, and end-to-end application/data flows involving Oracle and SQL Server.
  • Create and maintain Data Flow Diagrams, data lineage, metadata, system dependencies, and database integration documentation; support data governance, security controls, auditing, compliance, and impact analysis.
  • Evaluate and support AI-enabled database technologies, LLM/API integrations, natural-language database interaction, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Oracle AI Database capabilities, Infrastructure/Configuration as Code, and other emerging automation technologies; identify opportunities to improve observability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • The role requires occasional travel for training, team meetings, and due diligence events.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or a similar degree, with 5+ years of experience in IT System Administration, DevOps Engineering, software engineering, database administration, or a related technical role.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database in enterprise production environments, including performance tuning, backup/recovery, patching, upgrades, migrations, indexing, security, capacity management, and connectivity.

Exposure to AI/LLM integration, MCP, Oracle AI Database capabilities, and automated provisioning/configuration is preferred.

We are a staffing agency hiring on behalf of a residential property management company located in Seminole, Florida, serving the greater Tampa Bay area (including St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and Largo)

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and communicative Maintenance Coordinator to manage and streamline property maintenance operations.

This is a hands-on position for a proactive professional with practical experience in property management and maintenance coordination. You will serve as the primary point of contact between tenants, property managers, and vendors—ensuring maintenance issues and work orders are clearly communicated, efficiently scheduled, and cost-effectively resolved.

You will take full ownership of the maintenance workflow, driving issue resolution, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring a seamless experience for both property owners and tenants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work Order Management: Receive, triage, and manage property maintenance requests and work orders from intake through to successful completion.

  • Tenant & Stakeholder Communication: Clearly explain work order details, timelines, expectations, and resolution steps to tenants with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.

  • AppFolio System Operations: Maintain real-time accurate logs, records, updates, and documentation within AppFolio.

  • Vendor Negotiation & Cost Control: Actively negotiate and push back on vendor pricing to ensure fair rates, accurate scopes of work, and high-quality deliverables.

  • Vendor Sourcing & Onboarding: Continuously explore, vet, and onboard new service providers and contractors to build a robust, competitive vendor network.

  • Scheduling & Dispatching: Coordinate access with tenants and schedule contractors/vendors for timely property visits and repairs.

  • Invoice & Quality Auditing: Review work completion reports, audit vendor invoices against original quotes, and approve for payment.

Requirements

The successful candidate will have:

  • AppFolio Expertise:Essential. Demonstrable hands-on experience using AppFolio for property management and maintenance operations.

  • Exceptional Communication: Outstanding verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to handle delicate tenant conversations and firm vendor discussions.

  • Strong Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of negotiating pricing, reviewing job scopes, and holding vendors accountable.

  • Organizational Mastery: Superb attention to detail, strong multi-tasking capabilities, and the ability to manage high-volume daily requests efficiently.

  • Property Maintenance Knowledge: solid understanding of residential property maintenance issues, trade terminology, and standard repair timelines.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities to assess issues accurately before dispatching vendors.

This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who has previously worked in property management coordination and can hit the ground running.

Working Style

You should be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your workload in a fast-paced environment.

We will provide clear operational guidelines, but you are expected to take initiative, resolve conflicts proactively, and drive tasks across the finish line without requiring constant step-by-step supervision.

The right person will be:

  • Reliable, highly organized, and detail-oriented

  • A firm yet diplomatic communicator who is comfortable having tough conversations with tenants or vendors

  • Solution-focused with strong critical-thinking skills

  • Able to prioritize competing demands under pressure

  • Proactive in identifying cost-saving opportunities and discovering new vendor partners

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, GIFTSOFT & Cibar
jobs.excerpt: We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity.
jobs.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

Who we need

GIFTSOFT and Cibar provide specialized financial technology solutions that help financial institutions manage bank to bank payments, anti-money-laundering, trade finance and other complex financial operations. Together, and backed by Constellation Software, they combine deep industry expertise with technology designed to improve efficiency, manage risk, and modernize critical banking processes.

Reporting to the Aquila Portfolio Manager, we are hiring a Business Development Representative to create new sales opportunities for GIFTSOFT and Cibar. You will utilize the latest in AI and tooling to research financial institutions, identify the right contacts, and start relevant conversations with prospective clients. Representing each business, you will build an understanding of their solutions, generate interest, and connect qualified prospects with the appropriate sales expert.

This is a full-time, fully remote position.

What’s in it for you

Ownership and influence. This is a newly created role and a new approach to business development across the portfolio. You will work closely with the Portfolio Manager and the leaders in each business to shape how the role operates, from prospecting processes and ways of working to how activity and success are measured. As the model develops, your experience and insights will help inform how similar business development roles may be introduced across other businesses.

Broader sales opportunities. Working across GIFTSOFT and Cibar gives you two distinct sets of solutions and a broader range of prospective clients and conversations to pursue. You will gain exposure to payments, fraud, compliance, and global trade finance technology while developing your ability to identify where each offering can create value for financial institutions.

Career growth. You will have the opportunity to build on your business development experience in a role with larger accounts, complex sales cycles, and senior decision-makers. Working alongside experienced sales professionals across two businesses, you will deepen your understanding of enterprise software sales and build the skills and industry knowledge to take on more of the sales cycle as you grow. This role has the potential to grow into a direct selling role if successful.

How you will make an impact

  • Open new doors. You will research financial institutions (primarily banks) and identify new prospects for both GIFTSOFT and Cibar, finding the right contacts, recognizing relevant business triggers, and creating opportunities to start conversations.
  • Prospect strategically. You will be an user of Apollo and other sales and AI-enabled tools to research accounts, identify contacts, personalize outreach, build targeted prospect lists and manage campaigns. You will combine these insights with your own judgment to determine who to approach, what will resonate, and how best to earn their attention.
  • Start meaningful conversations. You will connect with prospective clients through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, introducing the GIFTSOFT or Cibar solution most relevant to their needs. You will tailor your approach to different stakeholders, priorities, and business challenges to create interest and open the door to further discussion.
  • Qualify and connect. You will develop enough knowledge of both businesses to confidently introduce their solutions, ask thoughtful questions, and recognize where there may be a fit. You will qualify genuine opportunities and connect prospects with the appropriate sales expert for deeper discovery and next steps.
  • Help build the playbook. As one of the first people in this shared BDR model, you will work with the business unit leaders, sales and the Portfolio Manager to refine target accounts, messaging, outreach strategies, qualification criteria, and measures of success. You will use activity and outcomes to understand what is working and help shape a repeatable approach that can evolve across the portfolio.

You bring

  • The hunter mindset. You enjoy opening doors that are not already open. You are motivated by prospecting, comfortable with cold outreach, persistent when response rates are low, and energized by turning an unknown account into a genuine sales conversation.
  • The outbound experience. You have experience generating new business through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, or other prospecting channels. You understand that effective business development requires research, consistency, thoughtful follow-up, and the ability to handle rejection without losing momentum.
  • The AI fluency. You are comfortable using AI-powered prospecting and productivity tools to research accounts, find contacts, personalize messaging, and work more efficiently. You know how to assess and refine AI-generated information rather than simply relying on the output.
  • The communication skills. You can speak confidently with stakeholders at different levels and adjust your approach depending on who you are engaging. You know how to create enough interest in an initial conversation to earn the next one without being the product expert.

Purpose of the role

We are looking for an engineer who knows the broadcast and video world in depth and can turn that knowledge into reliable software. You will be our go-to person for video formats, codecs, and broadcast-specific media handling within our MAM platform. You will work in a team on Kubernetes-based, GitOps-delivered services, with architectural guidance from our senior architects.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain media-handling features: ingest, analysis, transcoding, proxy generation, and delivery in broadcast-grade formats.
  • Analyze and resolve format-related issues (non-conformant files, interlace/frame-rate problems, audio channel mapping, timecode and metadata errors).
  • Integrate and tune transcoders and media tools (e.g. FFmpeg, MediaInfo, commercial transcoding engines) in containerized workflows.
  • Map and validate technical and descriptive metadata against broadcast standards and customer specifications.
  • Support customer projects and escalations with media-domain expertise.
  • Contribute to code quality and security (SonarQube, Mend) and to CI/CD pipelines.
  • Document format and workflow knowledge so it spreads across the team.

Must-have

  • Hands-on experience in broadcast, post-production, or MAM environments.
  • Solid knowledge of the video formatsin everyday use:
    • Codecs: H.264/AVC, HEVC, MPEG-2, ProRes, DNxHD/DNxHR, XDCAM HD/IMX, AVC-Intra, JPEG 2000
    • Containers: MXF (OP1a, OPAtom), MP4/MOV, MPEG-TS, ideally IMF
    • Video fundamentals: interlaced vs. progressive, frame rates (incl. 29.97/59.94 and drop-frame timecode), aspect ratios, color spaces (BT.601/709/2020), basics of HDR (PQ/HLG)
    • Audio: channel layouts and mapping, sample rates, loudness (EBU R128)
  • Experience with media metadata and subtitle/caption formats (e.g. EBU Core, SMPTE, BWF, EBU-TT/STL, TTML, CEA-608/708).
  • Practical experience with FFmpeg and media analysis tooling.
  • Programming experience in [Java / .Net / C#] and comfort working with REST APIs.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and Helm, plus Git-based workflows.
  • Structured, quality-conscious way of working; fluent English, German is a plus.

Tooling and stack

  • Platform: Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps (Flux or Argo CD)
  • Cloud: AWS (working knowledge: S3, EKS, IAM basics)
  • CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Quality & security: SonarQube, Mend (day-to-day use, fixing findings)
  • Media tooling: FFmpeg, MediaInfo, MXF analysis tools
  • Nice to know: OpenTelemetry/Grafana for debugging media pipelines

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with Vidispine or similar MAM platforms (Avid, Dalet, Telestream, etc.)
  • Delivery specs such as AS-11 (UK DPP), IMF, or broadcaster-specific specifications (e.g. ARD/ZDF)
  • Knowledge of live and IP workflows (SMPTE ST 2110, SRT)
  • Experience with AI/ML-based media enrichment (speech-to-text, face/object detection)
  • Familiarity with AWS media services (MediaConvert, etc.)

Soft skills

  • Curious and detail-oriented, enjoys getting to the root cause of a broken file
  • Explains media topics clearly to engineers who are not broadcast experts
  • Reliable team player who takes ownership of their area and asks early when blocked

What you'll do:

The position is an entry level fraud investigator/auditor position expected to work under the direct supervision of a team manager and/or team lead. The team performs high level complex investigations of medical professional service providers and develops cases/reports for future action, including referral to law enforcement, education, over payment recovery and other administrative actions. This position will support the team of fraud investigators/auditors and will work with internal resources and external agencies to develop cases/audits and corrective actions as well as respond to requests for data and support.

  • The investigator uses good judgment and will work under the direct supervision of team manager and/or team lead
  • The investigator/audit associate will work in support of a team who works with state and/or federal investigators and other personnel.
  • The investigator handles multiple caseload assignments concurrently; organizes and analyzes information in support of the team’s workload
  • The Investigator may also be required to assist in the completion of complex reports that apply regulations or rules to the program(s) affected by the behavior being reviewed.
  • Investigator will work collaboratively within the team and participate in researching and understanding the relevant offenses being reviewed; participate in conducting efficient and effective investigations/audits concerning those alleged offenses and detect or verify suspected violations; obtain information and evidence by observation, record examination, and interview.
  • Investigator/auditor will collaborate with team members to analyze the results of the investigation/audit to ascertain if the allegations have been corroborated and work with others to determine the appropriate steps that need to be taken to address the issues.
  • As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.

jobs.description:
Overview

THE OPPORTUNITY

Every month, renters pay for housing through property management companies, and that relationship gives us something rare: a trusted, recurring, high-frequency touchpoint with the resident. We are building the financial layer around it: payments, insurance, rewards, embedded financial products and a resident AI that ties the experience together. Partners are how that layer gets built, funded and made valuable.

As Head of Partnerships you will be the single front door for every external relationship that matters to our fintech business: the banks and financial institutions that power our products, the fintechs and platforms that extend them, and the consumer brands that give residents a reason to engage. You will build the network, structure the deals, and run the relationships so that each partner creates measurable value for residents, for property managers and for us.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Bank and financial institution partnerships. Own the relationships behind our money-movement and financial products: sponsor and issuing banks, BaaS providers, card networks and processors. Source, negotiate and manage them for resilience, economics and regulatory fit.
  • Embedded finance partnerships. Build the partner network behind embedded products such as loans, cards and other financial services, and structure revenue-share, funding and distribution models that work for both sides.
  • Resident-value partnerships. Source and sign consumer brands (streaming, mobility, retail, travel and more) that make the resident experience worth using, and shape offers that drive engagement and loyalty.
  • Strategic and existing partner relationships. Run the executive relationships with the strategic partners we already work with. Protect and grow volume, align roadmaps and manage performance, economics and renewals.
  • Deal structuring and governance. Lead commercial terms from first conversation to signature, with Legal, Finance, Risk and Compliance. Build a clear approval path, deal flow visibility and partner scorecards.
  • Partner activation. Great contracts are not enough. Work with Product, Resident Experience, Engineering and GTM so each partner launches on time, performs and scales.
  • Ecosystem strategy. Decide where we build, buy or partner. Bring a point of view on the fintech and bank landscape and where our resident ecosystem creates leverage.

HOW YOU WILL WORK

Partnerships succeeds when it works as one team with the rest of the business:

  • With Product and Engineering on partner requirements, integrations and roadmap trade-offs.
  • With Resident Experience on what residents actually want from a partner offer.
  • With GTM & Commercialization and Marketing on joint launches, co-marketing and adoption.
  • With Finance, Risk, Compliance and Legal on economics, diligence, regulatory fit and contracts.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING

Demonstrable partnership results are the heart of this role. We are looking for someone who can show us, with names, deals and outcomes, what they built.

  • 10+ years in fintech business development and partnerships, with a record of originating, negotiating and closing material deals with banks, fintechs, processors or networks.
  • Hands-on experience structuring bank and BaaS partnerships (sponsor or issuing banks, card programs, lending or funding partners) and managing them through diligence, launch and steady state.
  • A track record building consumer or resident ecosystems: signing brand and benefit partners, designing offers, and showing the engagement or revenue they produced.
  • Deep command of embedded finance and partnership economics: revenue share, take rate, funding costs, risk sharing and unit economics.
  • Experience running executive-level relationships and managing a partner portfolio for performance, not just signing it.
  • Comfort in a regulated environment: you know what banks, compliance and risk teams need, and you bring them in early.
  • A real network across banks, fintechs and consumer brands that you can activate from day one.

Nice to have: multifamily, real estate or property technology exposure; marketplace or platform partnerships; experience building a partnerships function and team from scratch.

WHY JOIN

  • A partner proposition with real pull. A resident base reached through property managers, a growing set of financial products, and a roadmap that gives partners something unique to plug into.
  • Scope and visibility. A direct report to the Chief Fintech Officer, a seat on the leadership team, and a scorecard the board sees.
  • Build, don’t maintain. You will set the partnership strategy, the deal process and the team.
  • Impact you can measure. Each partnership connects to resident outcomes and the numbers we report to the board.

Pay Range

USD $157,600.00 - USD $286,400.00 /Yr.

Provides analyst support for business requirements activities of moderate complexity. Responsible for accurate and timely intake and interpretation of regulatory and/or functional requirements related to but not limited to coverage, reimbursement, and processing functions to support systems solutions development and maintenance. Coordinates cross-functionally with stakeholders and subject matter experts to support business needs, and participates in governance committees as applicable.

This position requires advanced Excel skills. Please update your resume with any relevant experience.

Essential Job Duties

  • Develops and maintains requirement documents related to coverage, reimbursement and other applicable system changes to ensure alignment with regulatory and health plan/product requirements.
    • Monitors regulatory sources to ensure all updates are aligned.
    • Navigates analytical problems and clearly defines and documents unique specifications.
    • Supports development and ongoing interpretation of review processes, committees and collaboration with key partner organizations.
    • Recognizes, identifies and documents changes to existing business processes and identifies new opportunities for process developments and improvements.
    • Provides status updates to health plan/product team partners, senior leadership and applicable stakeholders.
    • Communicates requirement interpretations and changes to health plans/product teams and various impacted functional areas for requirement interpretation alignment and approval and solution traceability; coordinates meetings and champions/deploys operational process best practices.
    • Where applicable, codifies the requirements for system configuration alignment and interpretation.
    Provides support and/or requirement interpretation inconsistencies and complaints.
    • Assists with the development of requirement solution standards and best practices, and suggests improvement processes as applicable to consistently apply requirements across states and products.
    • Facilitates self-organized reporting to ensure health plans/product teams, leaders, and applicable stakeholders are aware of work efforts and impact for prospective or retrospective requirement changes that impact financials.
    • Conducts industry research and engagement to evaluate, provide insights, and develop/deploy best practices.
    • Coordinates with applicable teams for analysis, impact and implementation of changes that impact health plan/product.
    • Engages with operational leadership and health plan support functions to review compliance-based issues for benefit planning purposes.
    • Ensures end-to-end business requirements are documented, interpretation is agreed upon, and solutioning is clear for all applicable parties.
    • Develops and maintains relationships with health plan/product teams and corporate operations.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of operations/analyst experience in a managed care organization, health insurance setting or related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Policy/government and legislative review knowledge.
    • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to concisely synthesize large and complex requirements.
    • Ability to organize and maintain regulatory data including real-time policy changes.
    • Self-motivated and ability to take initiative, identify, communicate, and resolve potential problems.
    • Experience creating reporting tools/providing project/process updates.
    • Familiarity with administration systems.
    • Ability to work in a project team setting and complete individually assigned tasks within established timelines to meet desired deployment deadlines.
    • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
    • Effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to engage with stakeholders of all organizational levels.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project management/implementation experience.

• Health care experience.

  • Knowledge and experience with federal regulatory policy resources including Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
    • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP).

Company: Davey Resource Group, Inc.

Additional Locations: Kent, OH

Position Overview

The UVM UAS Remote Pilot 2 is responsible for operating drones according to flight plans, planning flight paths, and collaborating with other pilots to ensure safe operations. This role provides mentorship to entry-level pilots, performs safety checks, and maintains accurate records for drone inspections, repairs, and maintenance. Additionally, the pilot follows FAA regulations, supports data collection and analysis, and participates in flight demonstrations and application of treatments using unmanned aerial systems (UAS).

Job Duties

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to entry-level pilots, fostering their growth and helping them to enhance their skills.
    ● Operate a drone according to a specified flight plan, ensuring all tasks are completed and required forms are submitted as directed.
    ● Plan drone flight paths for routine cases, collaborating with other pilots and flight crews to ensure safe and efficient operations.
    ● Adhere to policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all FAA regulations.
    ● Report and record flight logs and findings, ensuring all necessary data is captured for each flight.
    ● Perform pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight safety checks.
    ● Maintain accurate records for inspections, repairs, modifications, and routine maintenance to ensure proper UAS functioning.
    ● Inspect and service drones, replacing parts as needed, and troubleshoot equipment issues.
    ● Assist in the preparation and application of treatments using UAS, including mixing chemical products and seed mixes.
    ● Maintain communication with supervisors and managers regarding issues, problems, and resolutions.
    ● Apply relevant regulations and compliance standards to ensure legal and industry-specific requirements are consistently met.
    ● Assist in the review of data requests and support the design of appropriate solutions based on flight data.
    ● Organize and capture data accurately, developing skills to ensure consistency and correctness in data handling.
    ● Conduct research and compile basic reports, summarizing data and statistical findings to evaluate efficiency and suggest improvements.
    ● Perform visual inspections during flight demonstrations, ensuring equipment functions as intended, and assist with flight planning and monitoring to support the overall demonstration.
    ● Organize and prioritize daily work assignments to ensure tasks are completed efficiently.
    ● Represent the company and the client at professional meetings and communicate ideas, technical information and industry intelligence as appropriate.
    ● Participate in required and recurrent training.
    ● React appropriately in emergency situations.
    ● Perform other related duties as assigned.
    ● Follow all company policies, procedures, and work rules.

Qualifications

  • Required: Valid Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107 license) from the FAA and approval for Part 137 UAS operations with completion of training or a degree in aviation, engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on commercial experience with a variety of aircrafts.
    • Required: Valid driver's license and successfully pass a driving record check.
    • Required: Must be at least 21 years of age to be a Department of Transportation (DOT) certified driver for specific vehicles or equipment.
    • Required: If flying aircrafts over 55 pounds, must hold an FAA Class 2 or 3 medical certificate.
    • Required: Minimum of 100 documented flight hours on relevant UAS types.
    • Required: Ability to acquire applicable licenses as necessary per state requirements.
    • Required: Experience utilizing FAA regulations and restrictions, including working with airspace, LAANC, geozones, FAA waivers, and unlocks.
    • Required: Experience in flight mission planning and various execution software.
    • Required: Extensive experience with various sensors for photography, videography, photogrammetry, and LiDAR settings per mission requirements.
    • Required: Knowledge in principles, techniques and applications of unmanned aerial systems (UAS).
    • Required: Comfortable operating a UAS in various weather and light conditions.
    • Required: Hand-eye coordination to effectively operate remote piloting equipment and ensure precise control during flight operations.
    • Required: Demonstrated experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and mechanical issues.
    • Required: Strong skills and capabilities in at least one of the following areas of expertise: Remote sensing experience with imagery processing and photogrammetry software packages like Pix4D, DroneDeploy, DJI Terra, Agisoft Metashape, ENVI, ERDAS IMAGINE, Global Mapper, and DroneMapper; other automated pre-flight and flight planning software such as AirData, DJI Pilot, UgCS and Auterion; or GIS experience with two or more desktop GIS software packages like Esri ArcGIS, AutoCAD, QGIS, Microstation, or other geospatial tools.
    • Required: Willing and able to travel, including on short notice, for emergency situations and disaster response.
    • Required: Ability to work independently and with attention to detail.
    • Required: Proficient in computer software and programs necessary to complete job duties.

jobs.description:
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto (NYSE: VLTO) is creating today.

With annual sales of approximately $5.5 billion, Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. Our industry-leading companies with globally recognized brands help billions of people around the world access clean water, safe food and trusted essential goods. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, our global team of approximately 17,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on our world and united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™.


Veralto’s Water Quality companies—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies and XOS—help our customers safeguard precious water resources by holistically addressing water safety and scarcity, responsible water management, and other water challenges brought on by climate change.


Our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Tracegains, Videojet, and X-Rite—help our customers safeguard everyday essentials by protecting the food supply chain, enabling the delivery of verified pharmaceuticals, and ensuring product quality, freshness, and consistency.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The candidate for Manager, Corporate Development will be a critical member of Veralto’s Corporate Development team and will support the evaluation and execution of acquisitions, divestitures, minority investments and other strategic transactions. The role combines rigorous financial analysis with cross-functional partnership with business leaders and functional experts throughout market assessment, due diligence, valuation, negotiation, approval and transition planning. The successful candidate will be expected to develop into an increasingly independent transaction leader while helping strengthen Veralto’s M&A capabilities and standard work.

jobs.description:
Overview

We are looking for an Agentic AI Architect I to help design scalable, reliable, and reusable architectures for production-grade AI agents. This role supports the AI Center of Excellence mission by helping product and engineering teams build, integrate, release, evaluate, and operate agentic AI solutions using shared platform capabilities and consistent architectural patterns.

You will work across product, engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, QA/Eval, operations, and support teams to translate business and workflow requirements into practical agent architectures. Your work may span agent orchestration, runtime services, tool and system integrations, workflow execution, observability, evaluation, responsible AI controls, and production support.

This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who can balance technical design, implementation practicality, reliability, and delivery speed. The successful candidate will help teams avoid fragile one-off solutions by identifying reusable patterns that can be adopted across AI agent products.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end architectures for agentic AI solutions, including orchestration, runtime execution, workflow management, tool invocation, system integrations, evaluation, observability, and supportability.
  • Translate product requirements, business workflows, and customer use cases into clear technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Define reusable patterns for multi-step agent behavior, task routing, handoffs, cross-system interactions, state management, and multi-agent coordination where appropriate.
  • Partner with AI Platform teams to use shared orchestration, runtime, evaluation, reporting, monitoring, and developer-tooling capabilities.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during implementation through architecture reviews, design guidance, technical documentation, and production-readiness assessments.
  • Evaluate architecture tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, maintainability, cost, developer experience, and delivery speed.
  • Help define integration patterns for APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, tools, model services, and Model Context Protocol, or MCP, capabilities.
  • Establish observability requirements, including logging, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, debugging workflows, and operational reporting.
  • Partner with QA/Eval teams to incorporate evaluation criteria, regression coverage, testing strategies, and quality controls into agent architecture.
  • Support release planning, launch-readiness reviews, production monitoring, incident response, and post-release improvement.
  • Identify repeated solution patterns and recommend when they should become shared product or platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to architecture standards, reference designs, technical decision records, implementation guidance, and reusable documentation.
  • Help teams apply responsible AI, privacy, security, governance, and human oversight requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Communicate technical decisions, dependencies, risks, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, operations, and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience designing or building backend systems, distributed applications, workflow platforms, integration services, developer platforms, cloud applications, or AI-enabled solutions.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, asynchronous processing, service coordination, event-driven architectures, stateful systems, and enterprise integrations.
  • Understanding of architecture principles related to scalability, reliability, performance, availability, maintainability, security, and production support.
  • Familiarity with LLM-based applications, AI agents, retrieval techniques, prompt and context management, tool calling, workflow automation, or model-driven products.
  • Ability to convert business and workflow requirements into practical technical architectures.
  • Experience with cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, logging, dashboards, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of testing, evaluation, regression coverage, release readiness, and operational support for production systems.
  • Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and explain architecture tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear diagrams, design documents, decision records, and implementation guidance.
  • Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, QA/Eval, security, infrastructure, operations, and support teams.
  • Ability to work effectively in an evolving technical environment where requirements and agentic AI patterns may continue to mature.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or implementing production LLM applications, AI agents, workflow automation, or intelligent assistant solutions.
  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, model gateways, evaluation frameworks, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI observability.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise platforms, internal services, APIs, data sources, and third-party tools.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol, tool integration primitives, structured outputs, agent memory, workflow state, and multi-agent patterns.
  • Experience with responsible AI practices, including safety controls, access management, data protection, human oversight, and auditability.
  • Experience creating reusable reference architectures, platform patterns, technical standards, or architecture governance.
  • Familiarity with production incident management, reliability engineering, deployment strategies, and post-release support.
  • Relevant cloud, software architecture, data, security, or AI certifications are beneficial but not required.
SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.
Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. jobs.excerpt: About MainspringMainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power.
jobs.description:
About Mainspring

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

  • Pragmatic Optimism
  • Excellence without Ego
  • Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview

    Site Integration Engineers report to the Project Engineering Manager within the Project Delivery department. A key enabler of Mainspring’s mission is the ability of its team to deliver solutions based on our linear generator technology that solve customer problems in the cross-section of resiliency and clean power supply.

    The project engineering team provides the technical expertise, guidance, and support to deploy linear generators into the field efficiently—building customer confidence and enabling future scalability. This role owns site-level readiness after construction is complete, ensuring that all mechanical, electrical, control, and communication systems are fully integrated, validated, and ready to transition into commissioning and operation. Generator commissioning is performed by a separate team; this role ensures the site is ready for it. Acting as the technical integration authority on site, this role bridges engineering design intent and real-world system operation.

Responsibilities

    This role will be responsible for:

  • Interpreting technical project details, including scopes of work, sequences of operation, control narratives, and engineering drawings (site plans, P&IDs, single-line, and three-line diagrams), and serving as the controls subject matter expert in design reviews

  • Verifying relay settings, meter configurations, and controller programming delivered by third-party integrators against approved settings files and design documents

  • Owning site readiness on assigned projects by validating installation quality and accuracy of balance-of-plant systems such as fuel, electrical, metering, protection relays, and communications; developing punch lists and driving issues to closure when discrepancies are found

  • Validating electrical and mechanical installations against drawings and specifications by witnessing and/or reviewing results of checks such as wiring and termination verification, grounding, insulation resistance and continuity testing, phase rotation, and electrical acceptance test (NETA) reports; and equipment setting and anchoring, gas piping pressure and leak tests, purging, ventilation and exhaust, and fuel regulator setup

  • Configuring equipment and verifying functional readiness of site-level control and communication systems prior to energization, including troubleshooting industrial communication networks (e.g., Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA)

  • Supporting integration with customer PLC/SCADA/HMI platforms (e.g., Ignition, SEL RTAC, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA Wonderware, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Schneider EcoStruxure) for system monitoring and control

  • Coordinating handoff to the generator commissioning team, confirming all site-level prerequisites are complete before units are started, and keeping project stakeholders updated on readiness status and next steps

  • Planning Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and system-level validation, defining acceptance criteria for customer and utility witness testing, and confirming that as-built operation matches design intent

  • Supporting Permission to Operate (PTO) by compiling documentation based on utility requirements and building an accurate submission package for the Interconnection team to issue to the utility

  • Owning site QA/QC documentation and ensuring systems are fully validated and ready for turnover to operations and the customer

  • Establishing repeatable processes, including ready-for-commissioning and ready-for-testing checklists, lookahead dashboards, SAT templates, equipment configuration and how-to guides, site procedures, etc

  • Travelling to project sites as needed to confirm readiness and perform necessary testing

Job Qualifications and Experience

  • B.S. degree in Electrical, Controls, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Equivalent field experience may be substituted

  • 5+ years in pre-commissioning, site commissioning, field applications, or controls engineering on power generation, battery storage, solar, microgrid, or industrial facility projects

  • Experience configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting devices and platforms such as:

  • Protective relays and automation controllers: SEL (relays, RTAC), GE Multilin, Beckwith, or ABB.

  • Revenue and power quality meters: SEL-735, Schneider ION, GE kV2c, or Itron

  • PLCs: Allen-Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7, or Schneider Modicon

  • SCADA/HMI: Ignition, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA (Wonderware), or Rockwell FactoryTalk View

  • Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA, DNP3) and OT networking

  • Ability to interpret single-line and three-line diagrams, P&IDs, control narratives, and sequences of operation

  • Understanding of balance-of-plant systems, including fuel/gas, low- and medium-voltage electrical, metering, protection, and communications, with the ability to read construction plan sets and acceptance test reports and a working knowledge of NEC and NFPA 37/54

  • Experience planning and documenting Site Acceptance Testing and supporting utility witness testing for PTO

  • Familiarity with field safety practices and energization standards and procedures (e.g., NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout), including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and arc flash hazard awareness

  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to safely use standard electrical test equipment (multimeters, phase rotation meter, network cable/fiber tester, power quality analyzers) in an active construction or live-plant environment

  • Strong documentation and communication skills, and comfortable coordinating contractors, integrators, and customers on site

  • Self-directed, with an ownership mindset and enthusiasm for building repeatable processes within a growing team

At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you.
