Our culture values smart, humble, and collaborative teammates who take accountability and drive results in an environment where their work truly moves the business forward.

We are innovative, scaling with purpose, and led by seasoned leaders who know how to build enduring companies. Trusted by brands like Instacart, Western Union, NBCUniversal, ZocDoc, and Sephora, we’re big enough to matter, small enough for you to make a real impact. If you’re excited by the grit of building, rapid learning, and shaping the future of customer growth, you’ll find your place here.

Branch is looking for a seasoned Customer Success professional to join our Customer Experience team as a Strategic Customer Success Manager. This role is dedicated to our most significant, globally distributed customers — large, complex organizations with vast ecosystems that span every major region. You’ll act as their trusted advisor and the connective tissue between their business and Branch, accountable for governance, adoption, retention, and measurable impact across the entire relationship.

Strategic accounts don’t behave like a typical book of business. They have decentralized buying centers, multiple business units, and intricate internal dynamics that demand deep, deliberate account management. As a Strategic CSM, you’ll operate a hyper-focused portfolio of named global accounts — running each as its own program, building multi-threaded relationships, orchestrating a cross-functional account team, and ensuring value is felt in every region you support.

You’ll drive adoption through demonstrated value, protect and grow flagship revenue, and lead the high-stakes conversations — consolidation, build-vs-buy, executive alignment — that shape how these customers invest in their long-term measurement and linking infrastructure. This is a role for someone who thrives on complexity, operates comfortably with senior stakeholders, and knows how to turn a sprawling enterprise relationship into a durable, growing partnership.

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll get to:

  • Own the full customer lifecycle for a focused portfolio of global, strategic accounts — running each as a tailored program with its own joint success plan, governance cadence, and value map.
  • Embed as a trusted advisor across decentralized buying centers and multiple business units, building multi-threaded relationships up to the VP and C-level.
  • Act as the “quarterback” for a global virtual account team — orchestrating Account Management, Solutions / Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering against a single account across all major regions.
  • Design and scale AI-powered customer programs by identifying high-impact use cases, developing repeatable playbooks, and enabling customers to successfully adopt AI across their teams and business processes.
  • Drive adoption and consumption growth by connecting Branch capabilities to each customer’s macro business strategy, and quantify impact across their business units and regions.
  • Own expansion and upsell motions directly on retention-focused (Defend / Maintain) accounts, and partner closely with Account Management to drive growth on accounts with active net-new whitespace (Grow).
  • Lead strategic success planning, QBRs, and EBRs tailored to each regional buying center, securing clear next steps on support tickets and feature requests.
  • Guide high-stakes consolidation and “build vs. buy” evaluations that reshape how customers weigh internal engineering investment versus partnering with Branch.
  • Navigate complex commercial and governance realities — custom MSAs, multi-BU and multi-region renewals, and procurement processes — and build the governance frameworks that keep sprawling accounts aligned.
  • Build compelling demonstrations, executive presentations, and business value documents that articulate ROI and reinforce renewal and growth.
  • Serve as the vital link between customers and Branch: set expectations proactively, surface and close gaps, lead customer communications, and support technical issue resolution alongside our specialist teams.

You’ll be a good fit if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience in Customer Success or strategic Account Management, including a proven track record of retaining and growing global flagship accounts (e.g., $1M+ ARR).
  • 2+ years of experience in the AdTech / MarTech space preferable working with large, global, or strategic-tier clients.
  • Comfort engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, up to the VP and C-level, across multiple regions and business units.
  • Demonstrated experience as an AI Champion, successfully introducing, advocating for, and scaling AI solutions that enhance operational efficiency and customer impact.
  • Strong business acumen — the ability to connect product capabilities to customer business objectives, P&L impact, and value-based use-case adoption.
  • A track record of orchestrating matrixed, cross-functional teams against complex accounts, and navigating decentralized buying centers and intricate org dynamics.
  • Experience supporting customers on cloud-based SaaS platforms, with enough technical fluency to lead solution conversations and support issue resolution when needed.
  • Excellent client management, written, and verbal communication skills, with a bias for action and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Comfort pulling and interpreting aggregate-level data using tools like Looker, Tableau, or Google Analytics to build a compelling value narrative.
  • A self-starter, entrepreneurial mindset and fluency with CRM and productivity tools (e.g., Salesforce, Asana, JIRA, Notion, Catalyst).

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The product decarbonization manager is responsible for supporting GE Aerospace’s evolving obligations in climate change mitigation and reporting, including on the company’s climate transition plan. The successful candidate will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product climate related topics, focusing on Scope 3 emissions and climate related matters. As an expert in the field, the Manager will support the efforts to implement effective GHG inventory management plans, as well as Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) assessments, ensuring alignment with global standards and certifications.

This cross-functional role interfaces with multiple GE Aerospace organizations and levels and blends sustainability activities with technical acumen, problem solving skills, and a broad view of the business and aviation industry.
The successful candidate is expected to interact with major external stakeholders and represent GE Aerospace in task groups that are working to address issues related to technical climate disclosures, carbon accounting, lifecycle analysis and GHG reduction claims.

In preparation for the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), the role will also help GE Aerospace build readiness for product-level carbon lifecycle, ecodesign, and circularity obligations, including Digital Product Passport (DPP) requirements.

Job Description


*** Candidates based in Ohio are preferred; however, US based remote candidates in the Central or Eastern time zones will also be considered.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Strategy leader responsible for leading all Scope 3 categories and reporting across all GE Aerospace businesses and products.
  • Lead development and execution of FLIGHT DECK standard work for Scope 3 categories including data collection, data analyses, calculation methodologies, and successful completion of internal and third-party audits.
  • Lead operating rhythms to review external Scope 3 and GHG Protocol methodology updates, emerging regulations, industry standards, and best practices, and define/lead execution of appropriate response strategies
  • Partner with Government Relations colleagues to identify and address broader business intersections with emerging regulatory challenges in the sustainability space (e.g. EU Taxonomy Regulation, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive, ESPR)
  • Contribute to and lead development of key content for GE Aerospace’s Annual Sustainability Report, CDP report, and other sustainability related disclosures
  • Support broader Sustainability Team activities on cross disciplinary projects and data requests including building a circularity program in GE Aerospace including partnering with key internal stakeholders to develop and operationalize standardized processed for product-level carbon lifecycle and ecodesign requirements under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), including Digital Product Passport (DPP) data requirements and durability, reparability, and recyclability criteria.
  • Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Product teams to embed circular economy principles (design for disassembly, recycled/recyclable content, material recovery) into product development in anticipation of ESPR ecodesign requirements.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university (in Aerospace, Mechanical, Materials, or Environmental desired).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in aerospace product engineering or knowledge of the aviation industry.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product engineering or manufacturing engineering.

Desired Characteristics & Experience:

  • Through understanding of the aviation value chain and the stakeholders involved
  • Solid understanding of carbon inventory management principles, including knowledge of Scope 3 GHG methodologies including GHG Protocol
  • Strong project management skills and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills combined with experience engaging in multi-cultural environments and at multiple reporting levels
  • Ability to develop and communicate technical positions to multi-functional teams with business and technical audiences in a clear and concise manner
  • Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering, business administration and a proven interest in global affairs
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Established project management, daily management, and leader standard work skills
  • Audit readiness and remediation experience
  • Experience fostering collaboration across various stakeholder groups, solid understanding of value drivers in partnerships
  • Experience with circular economy principles and product circularity strategies (e.g., design for disassembly, recycled/recyclable content, material recovery) is a plus.
  • Experience conducting or overseeing Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) (e.g., ISO 14040/14044), Product Carbon Footprint calculations (e.g., ISO 14067), or Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) is a plus.

Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. As the field-based point of contact for their therapeutic areas/project, the Senior Manager and their CTL team are responsible for building strong relationships with investigators and investigator site staff, identifying potential new investigators to support optimal placement of Regeneron clinical trials, and delivering against cost, quality and speed targets.

  • Extensive experience in global clinical trial operations required, with a track record of managing and developing field-based teams

  • Excellent communicator of technical and scientific information
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated collaborative as well as independent working style
  • Ability to build effective relationships with the external scientific community, including principal investigators and site staff
  • Strong organizational skills with effective use of time and prioritization
  • Cross cultural awareness and fluent in Business English
  • Strong operational Clinical Trial Liaison experience with consistent and excellent performance metrics
  • Coaching and mentoring

Role Summary

The Regional Medical Scientific Director serves as a role model for other field medical team members in ways that include on-boarding and/or sharing of therapeutic expertise.

Location Requirements: The position covers the following exemplar states: IL, MN, MI, WI, IN / Upper Midwest. This person must reside within the specified territory.

Scientific Exchange

  • Develops professional relationships and engages with national and regional SLs to ensure access to company-approved medical and scientific information on areas of therapeutic interest and Company products
  • Conducts peer-to-peer scientific discussions and maintains a reliable presence with those SLs to ensure they have a medical contact within the company
  • Addresses scientific questions and directs SL inquiries on issues outside of Regional Medical Scientific Director scope (e.g., grants) to appropriate company resources consistent with applicable policies

Research

I denne rolle hjælper du kunder med spørgsmål og udfordringer relateret til deres køb – fra bestilling til levering og videre. Du lytter til kunden, forstår deres behov og finder gode og effektive løsninger.

Hos Transcom er du aldrig bare en medarbejder – du bliver en del af et globalt fællesskab.

Vi er mere end 33.000 kundeoplevelsesspecialister i 29 lande fordelt på 90 lokationer, og vi leverer tjenester på 33 sprog til internationale brands inden for en lang række forskellige brancher.

Hos os bliver hårdt arbejde, samarbejde og engagement værdsat. Vi støtter hinanden, hepper på hinanden og arbejder sammen for at skabe positiv og varig udvikling – både i vores teams og i de lokalsamfund, vi er en del af.

Hos Transcom skal du kunne være dig selv fra første dag. Vi tror på inklusion, samarbejde og udvikling, og med den rette indstilling er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt vi kan nå sammen.

Vi er en arbejdsgiver, der tilbyder lige muligheder, og alle kvalificerede ansøgere vil blive taget i betragtning til ansættelse uden hensyn til race, hudfarve, religion, køn, national oprindelse, handicapstatus, status som beskyttet veteran eller andre egenskaber, der er beskyttet ved lov.

jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

As a Senior Security Engineer (Security Operations) at Sword, you will be at the forefront of safeguarding our cloud infrastructure and applications. Your expertise will ensure robust security measures, incident response, and continuous improvement.

Are you looking to join an incredible IT team, passionate about simplifying everyone's work? Look no further, we're hiring! We're a proactive team, constantly staying ahead to ensure everything runs smoothly. As an IT Team we understand the importance of technology in today's workplace and the impact that technical issues can have on productivity and efficiency. Want to join the team? Find out if you've got what it takes!

To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and continuously improve detection and alerting controls, ensuring high fidelity and contextual relevance to reduce noise and enable rapid response.
  • Architect, refine, and maintain custom YARA-L detection rules and SOAR playbooks in Google SecOps to automate triage, alert enrichment, and initial incident response.
  • Drive prioritization of alerts using a data-driven, scalable triage framework, aligned with business impact and threat context.
  • Lead end-to-end incident investigations in Google SecOps, leveraging complex telemetry correlation to proactively hunt for threats, contain active incidents, and drive root-cause remediation.
  • Proactively engage in threat intelligence and threat hunting, identifying new tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), enriching existing controls, and feeding insights into the detection pipeline.
  • Own incident handling from detection to resolution, collaborating with engineering, IT, and business teams to contain, eradicate, and recover from threats.
  • Define and maintain operational metrics for incident response, using them to drive continuous improvement in speed, accuracy, and organizational readiness.

What you need to have

  • Required: Public Trust Clearance - Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US public trust clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with strong understanding of cloud-native threats.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation and tooling development.
  • Hands-on experience with SOC tools and platforms, such as SIEM (Splunk, Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, etc.), SOAR, EDR/XDR, and log management.
    • Highly Preferred: Google SecOps/Chronicle
  • Strong understanding of incident containment and eradication strategies, with proven ability to coordinate response with technical teams.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (NIST 800-61, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001).
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to consume and synthesize intelligence about actors, techniques or situations to identify emerging risk scenarios.
  • Proficiency in process formulation and improvement.
  • Background in threat modeling, adversary emulation, and risk-based alert tuning.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to explain security risks and actions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional efforts in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to foster collaboration across InfoSec, IT, and engineering teams.
  • Forensics experience, investigating incidents and preserving digital evidence.
  • Leverage AI to automate and optimize security operations workflows, including alert triage, enrichment, and incident classification.
  • Design and maintain AI-assisted runbooks, ensuring consistency, auditability, and human-in-the-loop validation for critical decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve SOC efficiency through AI-driven automation, while maintaining strong controls and avoiding over-reliance on unverified outputs.
  • Integrate security tooling with AI platforms and APIs to streamline investigation, response, and reporting processes.
  • Enhance vulnerability management and incident response workflows through intelligent prioritization, correlation, and contextualization of findings.
  • Continuously evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and security implications of AI-assisted decisions in operational environments.

The Payer Contracting Executive will support Lumicera and all strategic partners for whom Lumicera provides shared services to help meet strategic goals and mitigate financial losses. This is hardware-channel language: margin, pull-through, sell-in, sell-out, ASP. Not edtech language.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain three sub-lists: IFP manufacturers (~25), tablet and laptop OEMs (~15), education-hardware distributors (~150).

  • Run multi-touch outbound sequences (LinkedIn + email primary, phone secondary) to channel heads, India-business heads, and product managers.

  • Reach 50–70 channel-head conversations per month across the three sub-segments.

  • Apply the hardware-variant of the qualifying questionnaire — device type, target segment, content-gap, bundling history.

  • Build a bundle-fit recommendation per qualified prospect — which 1–3 IME products ride well on this hardware.

  • Coordinate with Marketing for device-mockup collateral when LSM demos are scheduled.

  • Maintain quarterly cadence with dormant hardware contacts — cycles run 60–180 days.

  • Coordinate event-driven follow-ups around InfoComm India, BETT India, IFP brand partner meets, and state government procurement events..


Requirements

  • Skills Required:

    • 4–6 years of B2B hardware-channel sales, device-distribution, or technology-bundle sales.

    • Working comfort with hardware-channel vocabulary — margin, pull-through, sell-in, sell-out, bundle-economics, ASP.

    • Familiarity with the Indian education-hardware landscape — IFP brands, tablet/laptop OEMs, distribution channel structure.

    • Strong written outreach for LinkedIn and email — channel heads ignore generic templates.

    • Patience for long cycles; hardware bundle deals take 60–180 days from first contact.

    • Prior experience at an IFP brand, a tablet/laptop OEM, or in their education-channel team.

    • Awareness of state-government education-procurement cycles (Rajasthan, UP, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, etc.) that drive school-hardware volume.

    • Working understanding of EdTech content licensing economics (most candidates will lack this — it's a strong plus)


Benefits

Benefits Offered:

  • Competitive fixed plus performance-linked incentive, paid monthly.

  • Direct exposure to senior hardware-channel leadership across India's biggest device brands.

  • Cohort learning with extended 90-day ramp.

  • Path to Senior ISM, Cohort Lead, or hardware-vertical LSM / strategy roles.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking a Distinguished Engineer to research, define, and build the future of cybersecurity AI within our Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab. This role brings together frontier AI research, deep cybersecurity expertise, and large-scale systems engineering. The mandate is broad: understand where AI is going, identify new approaches to cybersecurity, and build systems that fundamentally improve how defenders operate.

You will build against what is possible today while anticipating what advances in models and agentic systems could make possible over the next 12-24 months. That means thinking about the entire application and the systems behind it, from models and agents to security data, tools, and execution environments. The work may span autonomous investigation, threat hunting, adversary simulation, detection, response, and remediation. Some of the most important use cases have yet to be defined.

As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be one of the senior technical leaders of the Lab. You will make original technical contributions while setting direction for teams working on these problems. You will identify important research questions, develop new approaches, build prototypes, establish rigorous evaluations, and help turn successful research into capabilities that operate at CrowdStrike scale.


What You'll Do:

  • Define the future of cybersecurity AI. Track advances at the frontier of AI and determine what they make possible for cybersecurity. Identify new capabilities and use cases early, with a particular focus on transforming how defenders operate. Set the research directions and technical approaches required to pursue them.
  • Invent and build new cybersecurity AI systems. Design end-to-end applications that reason across security context, use tools, coordinate, and execute complex security tasks. Determine how models, agents, security telemetry, and execution environments should work together to enable new capabilities.
  • Develop systems that improve through experience. Use investigations, adversary behavior, simulations, and expert feedback to improve system behavior. Explore how offensive validation and defensive outcomes can generate better evidence, evaluations, and training signals. Work directly with threat researchers, incident responders, red teamers, and other security experts to keep the research grounded in real-world defense.
  • Establish rigorous evaluations. Build benchmarks, cyber environments, and evaluation harnesses that expose capabilities and failure modes. Measure security efficacy, reliability, performance, and cost.
  • Set technical direction across the Lab. Lead consequential research and architecture decisions across teams. Work directly on hard technical problems, mentor senior researchers and engineers, and drive alignment through prototypes, experiments, and evidence.
  • Turn research breakthroughs into real systems. Carry promising work beyond demonstrations and solve the technical problems required to operate against high-volume security data and adaptive adversaries at CrowdStrike scale.
  • Contribute to the broader technical community. Represent CrowdStrike through research publications, open-source contributions, technical collaborations, and engagement with the AI and cybersecurity research communities.

What You'll Need:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Neuroscience, or a related quantitative field.
  • A sustained record of original work at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including research or systems that introduced new capabilities, approaches, or applications.
  • Deep cybersecurity expertise developed through significant technical work in areas such as threat hunting, detection and response, vulnerability research, adversary behavior, security analytics, or security automation. You can independently identify important security problems and opportunities for applying AI to them.
  • Deep hands-on experience architecting and building end-to-end AI systems that combine models, reasoning, tools, data, and execution environments.
  • Strong applied research instincts and quantitative rigor. You can formulate hypotheses, design meaningful experiments, establish credible baselines, and follow the evidence.
  • Experience taking sophisticated ML or AI systems from research prototypes to real-world deployment.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including setting research and engineering direction, mentoring senior technical talent, and influencing major decisions through technical depth and evidence.
  • Research or engineering experience with autonomous or multi-agent systems, long-horizon reasoning, adversary simulation, or closed-loop security systems.
  • Experience with adversarial learning, reinforcement learning, model post-training, synthetic data, or other methods for improving AI systems through interaction and feedback.
  • Experience building AI systems for high-volume, latency-sensitive cybersecurity environments.
  • Experience architecting and building extensible AI or agentic platforms that enable teams to develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy sophisticated AI applications at scale.
  • Contributions to influential research, open-source software, or technical communities spanning AI and cybersecurity.

Your expertise ensures that our regional network remains resilient, specifically focusing on European, Middle Eastern, and African carriers to directly impact the "peace of mind" we promise to our travellers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end incident lifecycle for Holafly’s global connectivity services, from detection and impact assessment through technical investigation, service restoration, customer recovery validation and closure.

  • Act as Incident Commander for major network incidents, coordinating L1/L2 teams, MNOs, IMSI providers, IPX/GRX partners and core-network vendors while maintaining clear technical ownership until resolution.

  • Lead and develop a team of 5–10 Network Operations engineers, providing technical mentoring, escalation guidance, performance management and ensuring strong operational readiness across the team.

  • Maintain deep technical ownership of live roaming and core-network services, including Diameter/DRA/HSS, GTP-C/GTP-U, PGW/PCRF, APN/DNS, IPX/GRX, routing, Local Breakout and 4G/5G connectivity, with the ability to independently analyse traces, logs and network behaviour.

  • Own network performance, monitoring and operational improvement, using KPIs such as first-attach success, session-establishment success, latency, packet loss, throughput, availability and MTTR, while ensuring seamless follow-the-sun handover between regional teams.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Mobile Telecommunications, with strong exposure to Core Network, International Roaming, Packet Core, IMSI/SIM technologies, IPX/GRX and mobile data services.

  • Strong technical knowledge of LTE/4G and 5G NSA/SA roaming architectures, including Diameter/DRA/HSS, GTP-C/GTP-U, PGW/PCRF, APN/DNS, routing and Local Breakout environments.

  • Proven experience leading major network incidents and technical troubleshooting, with the ability to analyse signalling traces, PCAPs, logs and network KPIs and drive incidents through restoration, RCA and permanent corrective action.

  • Previous people-management experience, ideally leading a Network Operations, NOC, Core Network or Incident Management team of approximately 5–10 engineers, with responsibility for mentoring, performance and technical development.

  • Strong understanding of IP networking and roaming connectivity, including BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, NAT, IPX/GRX, Diameter and associated troubleshooting methodologies.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills in English, with the ability to coordinate global MNOs, IMSI providers, IPX/core vendors and internal teams, challenge technical responses and communicate complex incidents clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Certifications in AWS, Cisco, or Project Management (PMP/Agile).

  • Knowledge of eSIM orchestration and GSMA standards.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote & Flexible Culture: Work from anywhere with a high level of trust and ownership in Europe.

  • Global Scale & Impact: Directly shape the connectivity experience for millions of international travelers worldwide.

  • Growth & Innovation: Opportunity to lead 5G transformation and cloud-native telecom architecture at a fast-scaling tech enterprise.

  • Competitive Package: Benchmark-aligned salary, performance bonuses, health coverage, and professional learning stipends.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Manager, Employer Brand Communications will lead the content strategy for Trinity Life Sciences’ employer brand and employee value proposition (EVP) communications program and its amplification across external channels. This role will bring Trinity’s employee experience, culture and impact to life across external channels to strengthen brand awareness and reputation, foster employee pride and engagement, and help Trinity attract top talent. The Manager, Employer Brand Communications will define the strategy, establish measures of success and lead execution in close partnership with Talent Acquisition, HR, Corporate Communications, Marketing and business leaders.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and lead Trinity’s employer brand and EVP content strategy, defining priority audiences, channels and content to strengthen Trinity’s reputation and competitive position among top talent.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR and business leaders to understand talent priorities, recruiting challenges and employee experience, translating those insights into strategic communications and campaigns that support talent acquisition goals.
  • Monitor employer brand and talent market trends, including competitor positioning and practices, to inform ongoing strategy and identify opportunities for differentiation.
  • Lead employee storytelling and content development that captures authentic voices and real experiences from across Trinity, through employee profiles, videos, blogs, social media and other formats; partner with Creative/Design to develop compelling, brand-aligned assets.
  • Own and optimize Trinity’s employer brand presence across external channels and platforms — including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, Handshake, Punchbowl and Trinity’s Careers pages — with a reputation and response management approach that keeps Trinity engaged with candidate and employee feedback in alignment with company vision and values. Build relationships with key platform partners to understand performance, identify opportunities and strengthen Trinity's presence and reach.
  • Build employee advocacy and employer reputation programs that encourage employees to share their experiences and engage with Trinity’s employer brand, including employee review initiatives, workplace awards and recognition programs, and amplification of employee and company achievements across PR, social and internal channels.
  • Develop and execute organic and paid campaigns across social, web and other digital channels, using SEO and digital best practices to increase the visibility and reach of Trinity’s employer brand and EVP; manage associated budget and external agency and platform partnerships.
  • Establish and manage a measurement framework to evaluate employer brand performance across reputation, awareness, engagement, audience growth and talent acquisition outcomes, using insights to optimize the program and demonstrate impact.

Future Growth & Development

  • Employee Communications: Partner with Corporate Communications and Knowledge Management team to evolve Trinity’s SharePoint presence and employee communications ecosystem, creating greater alignment between the internal employee experience and external employer brand.
  • Executive Thought Leadership: Partner with Corporate Communications, Marketing and business leaders to assess and develop an executive thought leadership program, including competitive research, program strategy, content development and measurement.

About Trinity

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at .


Trinity’s salary bands account for a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets and market demand for skills, level of experience and training, specific qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and other business/organizational needs. The base salary range for this role is $108,000 - $162,000 per year. In addition to your base salary, you will also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus.

Trinity’s Commitment to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)
Trinity Life Sciences is an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals. At Trinity, inclusion and engagement are at the heart of how we work and grow together. We’ve evolved from a traditional “DEI” framework to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)—a model that moves beyond representation to focus on connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. Every role at Trinity plays a part in fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. By embedding I&E principles into our culture, we ensure that belonging and engagement are not standalone initiatives—they are part of how we build teams, make decisions, and deliver excellence every day. Trinity will not tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment and encourages applicants of all ages and identities. However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

As we look to scale our Global Commercial engine, today is a particularly exciting time to join our team. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities. If you are ambitious, commercially hungry and ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

About the role

The Director of Sales, Middle East, will support AltoVita's Sales and Business Development efforts in the region, reporting into the SVP Sales EMEA. This is an external facing role focused on building credible relationships, opening doors with new prospects, and creating qualified opportunities.

This is a mid-level opportunity for someone ambitious, commercially hungry, and highly coachable, with real potential to grow into a more senior sales role at AltoVita as you prove yourself.

The Sales Director, Middle East, will be measured on revenue related KPI’s and will share responsibility and accountability for the success of AltoVita’s sales efforts in the region. Please note, this role will be based in the Middle East and you must have relevant work history. Please only apply if you have demand side experience, not supply side.

Your Responsibilities will be to:

  • Identify new business opportunities within the Middle East, including new markets, growth areas, trends, customers, and services.

  • Build a well diversified pipeline of qualified opportunities by seeking out the right contacts within target organisations and generating leads through outreach and cold calling.

  • Learn, master and fluently demonstrate AltoVita’s technology across all verticals and stages of the sales pipeline.

  • Consistently elevate AltoVita’s brand awareness through thought leadership, LinkedIn presence, and hosting high-impact webinars, roundtables and industry events.

  • Work with the Marketing team to support lead acquisition and nurturing.

  • Leverage your network to build genuine, credible relationships with prospective clients, employees, and other stakeholders.

  • Meet with prospects face to face or virtually, and attend relevant conferences and industry events to build AltoVita's presence in the market.

  • Act as a trusted first point of contact, earning credibility and open doors that convert into qualified sales opportunities.

  • Keep abreast of trends and changes in relocation, business travel, hospitality, corporate housing, and serviced apartment industries.

  • Develop, forecast, and report on your sales funnel whilst demonstrating full accountability

  • Optimise travel between the region to maximise sales efforts and minimise expenses.

  • Clearly and consistently communicate pipeline progress to your line managers and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with the Product and Client Development teams to feed back client needs and market learnings.

  • Hand off qualified opportunities to the enablement/closing team at the right stage, ensuring a smooth transition.

  • Learn and upscale to new verticals and geographies that are important for the company

What you will bring:

  • Core: strategic thinking, innovation, sound decision making, strong collaboration & communication, comfort with change, agility, and a client-centric mindset.

  • Leadership: ownership & accountability, resource and performance management, and a track record of developing others (as your book of business and any team grow).

  • Meta: a strong learning orientation, critical thinking & problem solving, and adaptability & resilience.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years in (external) sales in the Middle East region

  • 3+ years experience within the business travel or corporate housing industry

  • Tenacious and driven

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, sometimes less structured and entrepreneurial environment

  • Able to think strategically

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

Join our Team

AltoVita is the sum of every member of the team. We know that a strong team is a diverse team, and are therefore committed to being an equal opportunity employer, so please bring all of yourself to the interviews and most importantly to our team.

Becoming an AltoVitian means you will benefit from:

  • A team that will always put you first

  • Incredible opportunities for growth and career advancement

  • A fully-remote working environment

  • Wellness benefits and a wellness budget, which can be spent on a range of options including gym memberships, home meal delivery services, mindfulness applications, and many more

  • A work-from-home allowance to get your home-office set up

  • A generous vacation package so you can recharge or explore

Overview

MTF Biologics processes tissue grafts from human donors that are used in a growing array of clinical applications – positively affecting lives across the globe. As a global nonprofit organization that saves and heals lives by honoring donated gifts and serving patients, we collaborate with the medical, scientific, as well as organ and tissue donation communities.

Our goal is simple–do what's right for patients, surgeons, tissue donors, and their families through our guiding principles.

The Triage Coordinator/Triage Coordinator-Transplant (TC) is responsible for responding to incoming calls from hospitals and other referring agencies for both initial and update calls, collecting data regarding potential donors to determine if they are candidates for donation, and informing the caller of donation potential. In addition, this position will handle all organ allocation related processes for donation, transplantation and research. The TC will also be responsible for conducting medical interviews via phone with transplant patients or their designee to update their medical records relative to their transplant waitlist status. Additionally, they are responsible for completion of Fresh Tissue process regarding tissue testing on fresh tissue grafts, and data entry related projects or service.

Night shift with five 7.5-hour shifts per week.

$21-$25 an hour

Responsibilities

  • Answers incoming calls in a timely and professional manner.
  • Listens and responds to caller's needs for guidance and information.
  • Follows computer prompts to complete referral message and organ import offer process accurately.
  • Obtains necessary medical information regarding potential donors from the caller and documents/records information clearly and concisely.
  • Conducts state donor registry checks as applicable for all potential donors.
  • Memorization of key medical abbreviations and special computer codes needed for documentation
  • Places appropriate outbound calls to involved agencies per client protocol.
  • Relays all known information to appropriate agencies on cases status.
  • Receives and logs all fresh tissue graft cases per process and conducts all necessary follow up to secure test results related to the client process.

  • Performs Lab Data Entry function for all related projects/services.

Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

We are seeking a Modeling and Simulation (M&S) Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of advanced modeling, simulation, and digital engineering environments that support next-generation air traffic control capabilities. This role will drive the development of AI-enabled digital twins, system simulations, and decision-support tools used to evaluate system performance, operational scenarios, and modernization strategies across the NAS.

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced technical leader with deep expertise in Modeling & Simulation (M&S), Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), AI frameworks, and aerospace systems, capable of guiding teams and mentoring engineers while shaping enterprise-level technical strategies.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

This position is 100% remote.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and lead the development of enterprise Modeling & Simulation (M&S) solutions supporting FAA modernization and BNATCS initiatives.

  • Design and implement AI-enabled digital twin environments and simulation frameworks to model NAS operations, system performance, and modernization scenarios.

  • Apply Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles to support system design, integration, and verification activities.

  • Lead technical teams and provide mentorship to engineers and analysts involved in modeling, simulation, and digital engineering efforts.

  • Develop simulation models and analytical frameworks to assess system performance, risk, and operational outcomes across complex aviation environments.

  • Integrate AI/ML techniques into modeling and simulation platforms to enable predictive analysis, scenario testing, and decision support.

  • Conduct risk and performance analyses using simulation outputs to support FAA program decisions and operational planning.

  • Collaborate with FAA stakeholders, systems engineers, and program leadership to translate operational needs into simulation-based solutions.

  • Evaluate manufacturing, system integration, and operational considerations through simulation to improve lifecycle planning and deployment strategies.

  • Provide architectural oversight for simulation infrastructure, ensuring scalability, interoperability, and compliance with FAA engineering standards.

  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, simulation results, and architectural recommendations to FAA leadership and program stakeholders.

  • Support program strategy and business development activities by contributing technical expertise to proposals and solution development.

Why This Role Matters

FAA modernization is transforming how the National Airspace System operates. Every architectural decision must balance performance, safety, interoperability, and cybersecurity. As a Solutions Architect (SME), your leadership ensures that systems are engineered with precision and foresigh supporting the FAA’s mission to maintain the safest and most efficient airspace in the world. Your work will directly influence mission-critical aviation infrastructure serving millions of passengers daily.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12 years of experience, may have supervisory or management experience

jobs.description:
Role:Senior Software Engineer

Location:Wilmslow / Remote (UK)

We are The Citation Group - a collective of businesses dedicated to supporting small and medium-sized enterprises across a range of essential services. We know that running a business means juggling a lot. Our mission is to ease these pressures by providing expertise, guidance, and solutions that enable business leaders to focus on what they do best. From HR and Health & Safety to Cybersecurity, E-Learning, and ISO compliance, we’ve got you covered.

Citation Group has achieved strong growth through a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, continually broadening our expertise, services, and reach to create a one-stop shop that supports businesses across the UK, Canada and Australia.

Role Purpose

This is a hands-on engineering role at the heart of a significant platform transformation. You will be a core contributor to a squad that is actively changing how it builds, owns, and delivers software, and you will have real influence over the quality and direction of that work.

We are moving from a traditional release cycle to CI/CD, shifting shared services into team-owned boundaries, and embedding AI into how the team thinks and delivers. This is not a role where you maintain the status quo. You will be working alongside a Tech Lead to drive those changes forward, bringing technical craft and an AI-native approach to everything you build.

The right person for this role is someone who takes genuine pride in their work, wants to grow in a team that holds itself to a high standard, and is excited by the idea of building something better rather than just keeping things running.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Delivery

  • Write production-quality code every day across the full stack, covering backend, front-end, and the infrastructure that supports it.

  • Take ownership of features and workstreams from design through to deployment, delivering working software in shippable increments.

  • Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, bringing well-reasoned input and a practical perspective.

  • Run technical spikes and proofs-of-concept to explore approaches and reduce uncertainty before committing to a direction.

  • Manage your own technical debt responsibly, keeping the codebase in a state you are proud of.

Platform Transformation

  • Play an active part in the decomposition of shared services into team-owned components, taking on defined pieces of that work and delivering them with care.

  • Support the move to CI/CD by contributing to pipeline work, writing automated tests, and adopting trunk-based development as the default way of working.

  • Build with observability in mind from the start, covering instrumentation, logging, and monitoring so that your team can see what their systems are doing in production.

  • Contribute to the team's growing DevOps capability, taking on operational responsibility for the systems you build.

Code Quality and Engineering Practice

  • Write clean, testable, secure code and hold that standard consistently, not just when it is convenient.

  • Practise test-driven development and contribute to a culture where good testing is the norm, using AI to generate scaffolding and explore edge cases as part of that workflow.

  • Participate actively in code review, giving and receiving feedback that improves the work and raises the bar for the whole team.

  • Apply secure coding practices as a matter of course: dependency management, threat awareness, and security testing.

AI-Native Engineering

  • Use AI natively in your engineering work, as part of how you think through problems, generate and review code, and build and test solutions.

  • Contribute to AI-powered workflows that improve the team's delivery capability, whether that is in automation, testing, code generation, or observability.

  • Engage actively with the team's AI agents and tooling, helping to refine and improve them as your understanding of what works deepens.

  • Bring a critical eye to AI-generated output, verifying quality and maintaining the standards you would apply to anything else you ship.

Collaboration and Growth

  • Work closely with your Tech Lead and teammates through pairing, mob programming, and shared problem-solving.

  • Support less experienced engineers where you can, sharing knowledge through code review, pairing, and day-to-day conversation.

  • Contribute to planning, refinement, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives as an engaged and thoughtful team member.

  • Take an active interest in your own development, staying current with the technologies and practices the team uses and bringing new ideas back to the team.

Required Experience and Skills

Technical

  • Solid experience as a software engineer with a proven ability to deliver complex features on production systems.

  • Strong full-stack capability across backend and front-end development, with experience working with databases and cloud infrastructure.

  • Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes).

  • Sound security fundamentals: secure coding, dependency management, and an awareness of common vulnerabilities.

  • Experience working on evolving systems, including refactoring and improving existing codebases.

AI-Native Engineering Practice

  • Demonstrable experience using AI as a genuine part of your engineering workflow, not just as a code completion tool.

  • Comfortable working with AI-generated output critically, knowing how to verify, refine, and take responsibility for what ships.

Behavioural

  • High standards: you care about the quality of your work and take pride in shipping something you can stand behind.

  • Collaborative: you work well with others, share openly, and make the people around you better.

  • Self-directed: you can take a piece of work, make sensible decisions, and see it through without constant oversight.

  • Comfortable with change: you adapt well when priorities shift or approaches evolve, and you contribute positively to that process.

  • Curious and committed to learning: you keep developing your skills and bring new thinking back to the team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or Citation domains such as HR, Health and Safety, Compliance, Certification, or eLearning.

  • Experience building or contributing to AI agents or automated workflows in a production context.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or reactive systems.

  • Contributions to open source or active participation in technical communities.

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records
    Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines
    Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and action items to resolution.
  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • May provide direct supervision, training and/or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. Performs training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned. May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.
  • For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA II will use the business card title of Sr.Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:
    Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    As required, collaborate and build relationship with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
    The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff
    Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager
    Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.
    Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements
    Develop study and country level informed consent forms
    Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared

    Participate in bid defense meetings

    Provide input into Requests for Proposals (RFPs), scope and budgeting. Develop site management strategy.
    Participate in Case Report Form design and edit check development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Moderate level of critical thinking skills expected.
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis

Role: Architect - Platform Engineering

Experience Level: 10+ years

Employment type: Full Time

Location: Remote (Canada/US)


Role Overview:

  • We are looking for a highly skilled Architect - Platform Engineer to design, optimize, and scale infrastructure for GenAI and LLM workloads. This role is ideal for someone with deep hands-on experience in GPU profiling, distributed training, and high-performance compute environments.
  • You’ll play a key role in building out GenAI platform foundations, supporting production-grade deployments, and partnering closely with data science, MLOps, and application teams to bring cutting-edge AI solutions to life.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement scalable infrastructure for LLM and GenAI workloads across multi-GPU environments.
  • Perform GPU profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization for distributed training workloads.
  • Manage and schedule compute-intensive jobs using Slurm-based clusters and OpenShift/Kubernetes environments.
  • Enable and optimize the NVIDIA GPU stack (CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, Triton, RAPIDS, etc.).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy models in research and production environments.
  • Build and support GenAI pipelines (fine-tuning, RAG, multi-modal inferencing, LLMOps).
  • Develop reusable infrastructure templates using tools like Terraform and Helm.
  • Contribute to internal innovation (PoCs, workshops) and support client-facing delivery engagements.

Basic Qualification (BQ):

  • Strong experience with Slurm and distributed training environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Red Hat OpenShift and/or Kubernetes.
  • Deep knowledge of the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem (CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, Nsight, Triton/TensorRT).
  • Strong foundation in Linux systems, performance tuning, and multi-GPU optimization.
  • Experience deploying GenAI workloads (LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, multi-modal systems)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experience with cloud GPU environments (GCP, Azure, AWS, OCI) and/or on-prem GPU clusters.

Other Qualifications (OQs):

  • Experience with NVIDIA NIMs, DGX systems, or GPU-accelerated containers.
  • Knowledge of LLMOps frameworks and MLOps integration.
  • Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval systems for RAG architectures.
  • Comfortable working in client-facing environments and collaborating with AI solution teams.
  • Healthcare Domain Experience (Nice to Have):
  • Experience working with FHIR R4, HL7 v2, or SMART on FHIR.
  • Integration with EHR systems (e.g., Epic).
  • Understanding of HIPAA compliance and healthcare data privacy.
  • Exposure to clinical workflows, CDS Hooks, or patient-facing applications.
  • Experience building clinical decision support systems or healthcare interoperability solutions.

What’s in it for YOU at Quantiphi:

  • Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies.
  • Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues.
  • Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines.
  • Stay ahead of the curve, immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 500 companies.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

opportunities.

Someone who:
 Thinks beyond traditional SEO

and tools

 Is curious about AI and automation, and wants to apply it in real-world

Salary (No benefits unfortunately) - Ranging between R35 000 - R50 000 per month
The opportunity to work with a UK company, remotely from South Africa

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging.
jobs.description:
Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best-in-class clinical excellence, operations, and state-of-the-art technology across our platform.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer with deep expertise in public cloud Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) across AWS and Microsoft Azure, with strong skills in cloud networking, identity, automation, and platform engineering. The ideal candidate will excel in designing, deploying, and optimizing scalable cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on virtual network architecture (AWS VPC / Azure VNet), inter network connectivity, cloud routing, private service endpoints (AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints), DNS (Route 53 / Azure DNS), and hybrid network integrations using VPN and dedicated circuits (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute).

This role requires hands on experience implementing secure, high performance solutions using core cloud services such as compute (EC2 / Azure VMs), identity (IAM / Azure AD), serverless (Lambda / Azure Functions), API management (API Gateway / Azure API Management), monitoring (CloudWatch / Azure Monitor), logging (CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs), object storage (S3 / Azure Blob), relational databases (RDS / Azure SQL), and load balancing (ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway).

The engineer will leverage cloud native networking and security controls—including security groups / NSGs, NACLs / Azure Firewall rules, AWS Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, WAF (AWS/Azure), and DDoS protection (AWS Shield / Azure DDoS Protection)—to build resilient, well architected systems aligned with best practices.

The Senior Cloud Engineer will play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, improving network resiliency, and driving automation through services like CloudFormation / Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform, Systems Manager / Azure Automation, and AWS Config / Azure Policy.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities –

  • Design, implement, and manage multi cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure) with a focus on high availability, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Architect and maintain cloud networking solutions including AWS VPCs / Azure VNets, subnets, routing, load balancing, Transit Gateway / Azure Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints, and hybrid connectivity using VPN, Direct Connect, and ExpressRoute.
  • Collaborate closely with development, security, and operations teams to deploy and support cloud based applications, services, and platforms across AWS and Azure.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, Terraform, Ansible, and other infrastructure as code tools.
  • Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, and conduct capacity planning using CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ensuring reliable and efficient cloud operations.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including IAM / Azure AD RBAC governance, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance with frameworks such as HIPAA and Sarbanes Oxley.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure and networking issues across AWS and Azure, performing root cause analysis and driving long term remediation.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging cloud services, tools, and architectural patterns across AWS and Azure to improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and cross functional team members.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation for architecture, operational processes, standards, and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of hands on experience in cloud engineering or similar roles, with strong experience in AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Deep expertise with core cloud services including EC2 / Azure VMs, S3 / Azure Blob, VPC / VNet, IAM / Azure AD, Lambda / Azure Functions, CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs, RDS / Azure SQL, Route 53 / Azure DNS, ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway, and Auto Scaling / Azure VM Scale Sets.
  • Strong proficiency in cloud networking concepts such as VPC/VNet design, subnetting, routing, Transit Gateway / Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Private Endpoints, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, VPN, NACLs / NSGs, security groups, and load balancing strategies.
  • Experience with additional cloud services commonly used in enterprise environments, such as CloudFront / Azure Front Door, SQS/SNS / Azure Service Bus & Event Grid, KMS / Azure Key Vault, EFS/EBS / Azure Files & Managed Disks, SSM / Azure Automation, AWS Config / Azure Policy, and AWS Backup / Azure Backup.
  • Familiarity with cloud security services including AWS WAF / Azure WAF, Shield / Azure DDoS Protection, Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, GuardDuty / Azure Defender, and Security Hub / Azure Security Center.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, or similar automation frameworks.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline / Azure DevOps Pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security principles, identity management, and troubleshooting methodologies across AWS and Azure.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, ECS, AKS, and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Hands on experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Familiarity with Linux system administration, shell scripting, and operational tooling.
  • Experience with both AWS and Azure is strongly preferred.
  • AWS and Azure certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking) are highly desirable.

Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high-performance workforce.

Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: Overview The Senior Electrical Engineer will lead electrical design teams to deliver high-quality designs for new developments, upgrades, and redevelopments across a wide range of sectors, including power, process, healthcare, transportation, industrial, manufacturing, government, and institutional facilities.
jobs.description:
Overview
The Senior Electrical Engineer will lead electrical design teams to deliver high-quality designs for new developments, upgrades, and redevelopments across a wide range of sectors, including power, process, healthcare, transportation, industrial, manufacturing, government, and institutional facilities. This role oversees all phases of design and construction, ensuring electrical plans align with project budgets, technical standards, and client objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute complex electrical engineering projects using advanced techniques to develop new or improved systems, equipment, and methodologies.

  • Coordinate departmental or divisional design assignments, studies, and reports.

  • Perform detailed power system studies and system protection settings coordination for projects up to the 500-kV level.

  • Develop design basis documentation for protective settings and create native relay configuration files.

  • Conduct design reviews and support quality assurance efforts.

  • Collaborate with project managers to define scope and develop conceptual designs.

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers.

  • Contribute to business development and proposal efforts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, plus a minimum of seven (7) years of experience in electrical system studies within the electric utility or industrial power distribution sector.

  • A Masters degree in a related field with at least six (6) years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of the above.

  • Eligibility for Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience developing protective relay settings in transmission or distribution systems.

  • Proficiency with system modeling and analysis software such as ASPEN, CAPE, CYME, ETAP, or SKM.

  • Strong understanding of protection schemes and philosophies for transmission and distribution substations.

  • Ability to generate native relay setting files using SELs AcSELerator and GEs Enervista tools.

  • Skilled in interpreting single-line, three-line, schematic, and functional electrical diagrams.

  • Capable of performing and reviewing design calculations, including short-circuit analysis, CT sizing and performance, overcurrent coordination, distance element coordination, and relay loadability studies.

  • Experience performing grounding, arc flash, and other power system studies is a plus.

  • Ability to provide engineering support during construction and commissioning phases for substation projects.
