jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Support Operations Specialist, AI Agent Management supports the buildout and ongoing operation of Member Services Automated Operations. This hands-on individual contributor role sits at the intersection of conversation design, support automation, and Member Services operations. The role shapes how HealthEquity’s AI support agents communicate with members, structure interactions, detect intent, route issues, and hand off to human support while also helping build the operational workflows, integrations, guardrails, and monitoring needed for AI agents to safely resolve issues end-to-end. The role executes on the AI support optimization roadmap by configuring agent behaviors, improving prompts and knowledge, testing workflows, identifying automation opportunities, documenting standards, and tracking production performance against containment, resolution, escalation, quality, and member experience outcomes.

Reporting Structure and Work Setting

  • Reports to the Director, Automated Member Support Operations.
  • Partners with Member Services leaders, Human Support Operations, Strategic Programs, Product, Engineering, Digital Experience, Operations Excellence, Workforce / Operational Analytics, Quality, Training, Compliance, and other support partners.
  • Role may be performed remotely or in a hybrid setting based on business needs and company policy.

What you’ll be doing

AI Agent Operations and Optimization

  • Monitor deployed Member Services AI support experiences in production using containment, automation rate, resolution rate, escalation patterns, transfer accuracy, repeat contact impact, sentiment, quality outcomes, and member experience trends.
  • Design, tune, and test conversation flows, triage logic, prompts, knowledge content, detection attributes, guidance rules, tone, structure, and handoff behaviors across high-volume and high-impact support use cases.
  • Create and maintain AI optimization backlogs, including defect tracking, improvement hypotheses, testing notes, release documentation, and expected business impact.
  • Configure AI agent behaviors and workflow logic so automated experiences can safely take action, route cases, collect required context, surface relevant account or issue details, and escalate exceptions to the right human support path.
  • Analyze conversational data, frontline feedback, escalations, and support outcomes to identify opportunities to improve accuracy, resolution quality, and efficiency.
  • Partner with leaders and technical teams to prioritize improvements that increase automation effectiveness while maintaining compliance, quality, and member trust.

Low/No-Code Automation and Operational Tooling

  • Identify manual workflows, operational pain points, and teammate experience opportunities where AI agent action-taking, workflow automation, or lightweight tooling can improve speed, accuracy, consistency, or productivity.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and support low/no-code tools, internal automations, AI agent workflows, and operational aids for Member Services users.
  • Document build standards, user instructions, support processes, access requirements, and operational controls for tools owned or maintained by Automated Operations.
  • Support integrations between AI support experiences and approved internal systems or vendor platforms so agents can retrieve information, trigger defined actions, support status awareness, and reduce manual handling when appropriate.
  • Design guardrails, validation logic, exception handling, and escalation paths for automated workflows that affect member outcomes, account servicing, or operational decisioning.
  • Support pilots and launches of automation solutions, including training, feedback collection, adoption tracking, and post-launch improvement planning.
  • Maintain awareness of enterprise technology standards, security requirements, data handling expectations, and change management practices.

Automated Operations Governance and Quality

  • Follow governance practices for testing, documentation, user acceptance, safe execution, release readiness, defect management, auditability, exception handling, and ongoing production support.
  • Participate in regular inspection rhythms for AI agent performance, automation outcomes, workflow reliability, incident trends, and operational risk areas.
  • Escalate issues requiring Product, Engineering, Compliance, Privacy, Security, or operational leadership review.
  • Translate operational requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, test cases, and prioritized improvement work.
  • Help ensure AI and automation experiences are understandable, measurable, supportable, and aligned with Member Services operating expectations.

Capability Development and Knowledge Sharing

  • Contribute to the creation of repeatable Automated Operations playbooks, templates, standards, and training materials.
  • Share practical knowledge with Member Services team members learning low/no-code development, AI agent optimization, automation testing, and operational governance.
  • Support short-term assignments, pilots, and capability-building efforts that convert Member Services domain expertise into scalable automated operations capacity.
  • Stay current on AI support technology, internal tools, workflow automation capabilities, and practical use cases relevant to Member Services.

What you will need to be successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations Management, Computer Science, or related discipline preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in support operations, customer operations, automated operations, support engineering, chatbot / AI agent configuration, digital support, workflow automation, quality, training, process improvement, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze operational problems, document workflows, test solutions, and drive practical improvements.
  • Hands-on experience configuring AI agents, chatbots, automation tools, support workflows, or low/no-code tooling required; experience with platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, Salesforce, contact center AI platforms, workflow builders, or similar tools preferred.
  • Experience designing conversation flows, prompts, tone, structure, intent detection, categorization logic, or AI-to-human handoff experiences preferred.
  • Experience working with integrations, APIs, workflow builders, system configuration, or technical implementation partners strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in regulated, compliance-focused, or quality-sensitive support environments preferred.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to translate frontline operational knowledge into AI agent improvement opportunities, automation requirements, and testable solutions.
  • Fluent using low/no-code development tools, prompt/workflow configuration, reporting tools, and operational systems.
  • Thinks in terms of conversation design and understands how tone, structure, flow, context collection, and escalation timing shape the member experience.
  • Technically comfortable working with integrations, workflow builders, configuration tools, and operational systems without requiring engineering support for every change.
  • Understands that enabling AI agents to take action requires careful attention to guardrails, edge cases, validation, privacy, compliance, and safe execution paths.
  • Uses metrics such as automation rate, containment, resolution rate, CSAT, escalation rate, repeat contact, and defect trends to evaluate whether AI capabilities are working and where to iterate.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across business and technical teams, manage ambiguity, and deliver measurable outcomes through iterative improvement.
  • Sound judgment regarding member experience, operational risk, compliance, privacy, and data handling expectations.

Physical / Mental Requirements and Demands

Quanta’s culture is about creating an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued.

About this Role

JOB TITLE: Procurement Manager

QUANTA COMPANY: Quanta Government Solutions, LLC

DEPARTMENT: Preconstruction and Proposal Operations

LOCATION: Remote with site travel

REPORTS TO: Director, Preconstruction Operations

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are seeking an experienced federal procurement leader to run day-to-day procurement for a growing federal EPC prime contractor. Working under the Director of Preconstruction and Proposal Operations, you will implement the QGS procurement policy and plan across our Energy and Department of War work and build a purchasing operation that holds up to government review. You will source and buy for pursuits and awarded projects. Every purchase file you touch should be ready for an auditor the day it closes.

What You'll Do

  • Implement and run the QGS procurement policy, plan, and procedures under the Director’s leadership, and keep the written procedures current as regulations change.
  • Lead sourcing for pursuits and awarded work: RFQs, competition, quote leveling, and documented price or cost analysis, including sole-source justifications when competition is not practical.
  • Build and maintain purchase files that are audit-ready, covering competition, price reasonableness, source selection, exclusion checks in SAM, and consent to subcontract when the prime contract requires it.
  • Make sure the right federal requirements and flowdowns reach every buy, including Buy American, Section 889, cybersecurity clauses where they apply, labor standards, and small business subcontracting plan goals and reporting.
  • Maintain procurement integrity and conflict-of-interest controls, support mandatory disclosure reviews with Contracts and Legal, and apply pass-through charge limits to affiliate and lower-tier subcontracts.
  • Obtain and review subcontractor cost or pricing data when the applicable threshold and contract require it.
  • Apply the Director’s preferred-provider decisions between Quanta affiliate companies and external firms, and document price reasonableness for every affiliate buy to the same standard as an external buy.
  • Maintain the qualified supplier and subcontractor list, prequalification, and performance scorecards.
  • Plan material and long-lead procurement against the project schedule, and track commitments through delivery.
  • Hand complete award packages to the Contracts Manager for drafting and the sourcing file to the Award Transition Project Manager, then own material and long-lead buyout from execution through delivery so awarded work starts fully bought out.
  • Prepare for and support purchasing system reviews and customer audits, and run periodic self-audits of procurement files.
  • Build and develop the procurement team as volume grows, participating in hiring with final decisions made by the Director.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of procurement or subcontract management experience, including at least 5 years supporting federal construction or EPC work as a prime contractor.
  • Working knowledge of FAR Part 44 subcontracting policies, small business subcontracting plans, Buy American requirements, and cost and price analysis.
  • Familiarity with DFARS purchasing system criteria (DFARS 252.244-7001), and with DEAR requirements for DOE work.
  • Experience preparing for or supporting a Contractor Purchasing System Review (CPSR) is strongly preferred.
  • Strong negotiation skills and sound judgment on price reasonableness.
  • Experience with ERP purchasing modules; Deltek Costpoint and Procore are a plus.
  • Clear communication with project teams, estimators, subcontractors, and suppliers.

Work Environment:

  • Primarily office-based, with occasional travel to project sites, suppliers, and subcontractor facilities.

Preferred Licenses/Certifications

  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM) or Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM)
  • Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM)
  • Ability to obtain a DOE security clearance

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

jobs.description:
Local Project Coordinator - Équateur Province, DRC for Gender Outcomes in Jurisdictional REDD+ Program

Term: Full time, initial term 1 year
Location: Équateur Province, DRC (Work a min of 4 overlapping hours with the North America Central time zone)

Company Summary

Founded in 2006, Terra Global is a woman-founded, woman-run for-profit social enterprise, and small business. Terra Global's mission is to attract private sector capital to Nature-based Solutions (NbS) to produce significant climate change mitigation, community and biodiversity benefits. Terra Global is an industry leader in NbS program development, land-use greenhouse gas and impact quantification, and climate asset creation, with experience in 40 countries at project and jurisdictional scales. Terra Global is the only company with end-to-end knowledge of carbon development and climate finance transactions. We deliver proven expertise working on-the-ground with local partners, while leveraging financial and transaction structuring expertise to equitably balance risk and return between Investors and Investees.

Project Background

The Integrating Gender Outcomes-Based Financing into a JREDD+ Program in Équateur Province, DRC grant is piloting an innovative model that integrates verified gender impact outcomes into a Jurisdictional REDD+ (JREDD+) Program in the Équateur Province, DRC and seeking to attract outcome-based finance that complements climate finance. While JREDD+ programs are effective at mobilizing climate finance to reduce deforestation, they do not explicitly measure or fund women’s contributions or activities that benefit women, despite women being central actors in forest conservation and community livelihoods. In the Équateur Province, forest-dependent communities manage extensive forest areas through Community Forest Concessions (CFCLs). Within these systems, women play a critical role in subsistence agriculture and fuelwood, and Non-Timber Forest Product (NTFP) collection. However, they face persistent structural barriers, including limited access to income-generating opportunities, restricted control over assets, exclusion from decision-making processes, and disproportionate unpaid labor burdens. These factors limit the effectiveness and durability of forest conservation efforts. Inclusive, equitable programs improve compliance, reduce conflict, and bolster environmental outcomes. Despite this, existing REDD+ financing channels often do not explicitly recognize the important role women play in forest conservation.
This pilot aims to address that gap by designing a Gender Based Outcome Finance Program embedded within a JREDD+ Program, using the W+ Standard[1] to define, measure, and verify outcomes across key domains related to women’s empowerment (access to income and assets, time savings, and leadership). The pilot will design a Gender Based Program that benefits approximately 4,556 women across 28 villages in five CFCLs, covering over 115,000 hectares of threatened forest area. This pilot will be co-designed with local partners and beneficiaries through participatory consultations, Theory of Change (TOC) workshops, and capacity building sessions.
Outcomes for the 12-month grant period include:
  • Conduct community consultation with gender focus.
  • Design Gender-focused activities through a participatory process.
  • Define baseline for gender outcomes under the W+ Standard.
  • Develop the Monitoring plan in accordance with the W+ Standard.
  • Develop the W+ Project Description Document (PDD).
  • Pilot the demand for Gender Based Outcome Finance.

Responsibilities

The Local Project Coordinator will provide technical support and coordination for the engagement with Concessions Forestières des Communautés Locales (Local Community Forest Concessions-CFCLs). This will be overseeing and supporting the implementation partners (CFCL operators) to design gender focused activities, collect field data and implement activities to meet W+ Standard requirements. This role will lead the coordination between the Terra Global (International team), implementing partners, and the project participants (CFCLs) in the Équateur Province.
The main activities to be implemented by the Local Project Coordinator will include but are not limited to the following:

Coordinate Field Activities

  1. Lead coordination with all local implementation partners, communities, and government stakeholders so that key project activities are implemented on schedule and under budget.
  2. Lead and facilitate participatory consultation sessions with communities and partners to gather inputs and feedback and process those inputs in project plans, Theory of Change (TOC) documentation, and other project deliverables.
  3. Facilitate inclusive sessions in which women and other under-represented groups can meaningfully participate.
  4. Document in-field activities to demonstrate results of engagement processes and FPIC
  5. Support data collection to define the baseline conditions for gender outcomes in the project areas.
  6. Serve as the day-to-day point of contact person between Terra Global and local partners. Assess and communicate risks, delays, and partner needs to the Terra Global International team in a timely manner.


Coordinate Office-based Activities

Support and act as a liaison for Terra Global and the project including:
  1. Support all partners to follow best practice communication with Terra Global, including scheduling weekly calls and meetings.
  2. Contribute to sections of technical reports, including the W+ Standard Project Description Document (PDD).
  3. Support fiscal management procedures for the Équateur Province W+ Pilot.
  4. Support the procurement of goods for local partners and participants.
  5. Support translation for the international team both remotely and in country (French, local language(s), and English).
  6. Ensure consistent and timely flow of information and data from the field to the Terra Global International team.
  7. Engage with the provincial and national government and identify governmental focal points within relevant agencies for the success of the Project.

Gender-Focused Programming

  1. Provide gender-specific expertise to design gender-sensitive and gender-focused initiatives, in collaboration with partners and communities.
  2. Help partners and communities identify opportunities and barriers for women in the project context, and reflect these in activity design.
  3. Support the identification and documentation of women’s empowerment outcomes consistent with W+ Standard requirements.

Lead Monitoring Data Collection

Work closely with the local partners and local communities, lead field activities to gather, organize and store field-based data for monitoring the Project. These monitoring data needs tasks include:
  1. Collect and report operational data on project activities, using templates and methods required under the grant, W+ Standard, and Terra Global.
  2. Maintain organized, accurate records of activities, participants, site visits, and meetings.
  3. Prepare regular progress updates and field reports for Terra Global and to fulfill grant reporting requirements.

Secondary Responsibilities: Jurisdictional REDD+ Program Support

The LPC will also support the associated jurisdictional REDD+ Program, which is under development. Time spent on this work is secondary to the W+ pilot. The tasks are as follow:
  1. Collaborate with partners and stakeholders on key REDD+ deliverables, including work plans, budgets, and assessments.
  2. Carry out other field work for the REDD+ Program as required.
  3. Share field insights between the W+ Pilot and the REDD+ Program to ensure the two are aligned.

Qualifications

Required

  • DRC national, based in Équateur Province, with knowledge of forest management and the ability to travel frequently to remote rural areas
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience in program management and monitoring, including coordination of multiple partners and activities, natural resource management and/or REDD+ projects
Expertise in gender and/or community development work in DRC or a similar context
  • Fluency in Lingala, French and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Home-based is in Équateur Province
  • Proficiency with MS Office programs, especially Excel and Word
  • Experience on drafting progress and monitoring reports
  • Familiarity with mobile-based monitoring tools and smartphone applications for field data collection (Kobo, SMART, Survey123 or others)
  • Experience in capacity building, facilitation, and promoting adoption of tools and practices at the community level
  • Demonstrated success in building strong relationships with government institutions, community organizations, and local stakeholders
  • Able to work independently and self-manage deadlines and deliverables
  • Exceptional verbal/written communication skills, especially working across cultures
  • Access to regular electricity and internet (as is reasonable within DRC’s infrastructure)
  • Ability to travel extensively throughout the province and spend 1-2 weeks per month in the field.
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle or motorbike suitable for fieldwork (travel costs will be reimbursed per Terra’s travel policies)
  • Interpersonal Skills:
    • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trust with women, communities, government officials, and implementation partners.
    • Cultural sensitivity, humility, and respect for local knowledge and customs.
    • Excellent facilitation and active-listening skills, including with underrepresented groups.
    • Diplomacy and sound judgment when navigating competing priorities or sensitive issues.
    • Collaborative working style across field-based and international teams.
    • Strong organization, adaptability, initiative, and practical problem-solving.
    • Ability to communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
    • Commitment to confidentiality, safeguarding, inclusion, and ethical conduct.

Desirable

  • Demonstrated and successful past performance building relationships and negotiating with governmental authorities (local, regional and national), non-governmental organizations (NGOs);
  • Experience implementing community-based projects in field settings, including with local governance structures
  • Comfortable working across cultures and maintaining professional relationships with diverse partners

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

The Platform

The Phoenix platform is the continuous, connected intelligence layer that makes Sword’s AI Care solutions come alive. It provides the building blocks across member experience, clinician efficiency, and customer support for Sword’s products to ship integrated, delightful, and differentiated care.
By carefully designing and maintaining these blocks while driving AI innovation, the Phoenix Platform enables teams to ship fast and well without rework.

  • Own the trade-offs that shape the platform: cost, latency, quality, and when to move to open source models or bring something in-house;
  • Scope initiatives with Engineering, AI, and Product teams, carefully balancing reusability with differentiation;
  • Execute by iterating closely with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Operations to guarantee scope adapts and deliverables do not drift from high-value member experiences;

  • Own safety alongside our clinical team. Our agents talk to people about their bodies and their recovery, and you’ll know how we prevent, detect, and respond when they get something wrong.

What you need to have

  • 5+ years in product management, including recent hands-on ownership of an AI-powered product;
  • Significant technical depth in AI, generative AI in particular. You understand how models, prompting, retrieval, and agent architectures actually behave, not just what they’re supposed to do;
  • You’ve put LLM-based features in front of real users and dealt with what came back: the evaluation, the annotation, the observability, the failure modes nobody predicted;
  • You can hold your own in an AI or engineering discussion, and follow a nuanced technical decision through to what the member will actually experience;
  • You disagree up and sideways. We expect pushback any time the member experience is being compromised, whatever the source;
  • Ability to efficiently track the state of the art and, exercising sound product and technical taste, bring innovation;
  • You write and speak clearly enough to cut through noise. At our size that’s a load-bearing skill, not a nice-to-have;
  • You get real leverage out of coding agents: debugging, data analysis, production monitoring, small builds, one-off tooling, research, process automation. No slop;
  • You can manage and grow a small product team.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

Short Description

The Data Exchange Developer III will be part of the IT data exchange group and will be required to work closely with various departments within the organization.

The individual analyzes, designs, documents, tests, troubleshoots and coordinates implementation of application and device interfaces.

Interact with business owners and IT colleagues for discovery build and testing.

Works with application and interface analysts as well as various third parties to translate interface requirements into technical specifications.

The position holder will be responsible for providing guidance to junior staff as well as plan and help manage architect, artifacts, compliance and upgrade software.

The position holder will be responsible for understanding Epic Bridges architecture, new features, forms and functions as well as help implement FHIR platform.

Integration – responsible for the operation of the application and device data interface tool set (interface engines) and environment; as well as the operation of the application and device data interfaces through the use of the integration toolset (interface engines) and standards such as HL7, X12, and DICOM, and open system scripting / job control.

Application data interfaces are used to connect applications at the data transaction level, usually in real-time. Sharing data electronically eliminates redundant entry of source data and reduces the opportunity for keying errors.

Device data interfaces are used to capture vital signs and other bio-data from patient monitoring medical devices and transfer that data into the EHR for review and recording in real-time.

This reduces the effort required to record data as well as the opportunity for keying errors.

Bridges – responsible for the operation of the (Bridges) interface toolkit of the Epic EHR. Bridges is one of the modules that enable data to be transported into and out of Epic, both application and device data.

FHIR – responsible for implementing and assisting in FHIR adoption strategy.

Focus on accuracy, efficiency, security (PHI), extensible data model, storage, querying and data exchange policies. BUILD/PROGRAM

  • Works independently developing new application/device data interfaces or enhancements to existing interfaces.
  • Develop Data Exchange architectural skills, and provide advisory input to deploy robust and scalable solutions, especially on-boarding new data points from Epic Bridges.
  • Maintains awareness of integration and technological developments and trends, providing periodic briefings to management.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT· Manages small to medium size projects. Track on-time completion and stabilization. Report roadblocks so that timely actions can be taken. DOCUMENTATION· Develop and maintain up to date documentation relating to the Data Exchange Team.SUPPORT· Develop and implement interface testing strategy so that updates to an existing interface can be managed efficiently.· Functions as a technical resource to other IT staff, IT management, and the client community.· Willing to assume on-call responsibilities as and when needed.

Experience Required

6 years minimum of strong Data Exchange experience, including the development, maintenance, and operation of the application and device data interfaces through the use of the integration toolset (interface engines e.g Corepoint, GlobalScape EFT) and standards such as HL7, X12, and DICOM, and open system scripting / job control.

10+ years experience in Healthcare IT will be considered.

Epic experience is plus.

Education Requirements

Bachelor ’s degree in computer science, software development, business administration or related field Required

10 additional years of comparable work experience beyond the required years of experience maybe substituted in lieu of an Bachelor’s degree

License/Certification Requirements

Epic Bridges Certification

Familiarity with the HL7, XML, FHIR Standard

CorePoint certification (within 60 days of hire) Preferred

Value Proposition

Our values define us and our culture inspires us to change lives for the better. Our employees are the heart and soul of our company, and every success we experience begins with them. Together we are committed to making a positive impact in our local communities. We champion a culture of continuous learning, work-life integration, and inclusion. We promote a digitally enabled work environment to continuously enhance the experience of our employees and customers.

Overview

This full-time position is remote and open to candidates residing within the Mid and South-Atlantic region. Travel to the corporate headquarters in Lancaster, PA will be required on an as-needed basis.

The primary responsibility of this role is to support the Consumer Compliance Department and Program through the development, implementation and delivery of reports, dashboards and metric-level analysis to identify, assess, monitor and report consumer compliance risk. The incumbent partners with Enterprise Risk Management, Business Lines, Internal Audit, and Technology teams to develop reporting and analytics supporting compliance monitoring and testing, complaint management, fair lending, Community Reinvestment Act (CRA), Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP) and regulatory change management activities. This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity and governance of compliance data utilized in risk assessments, issue management, examination management, regulatory reporting and other compliance programs. The incumbent translates complex datasets into conclusions and actionable insights support consumer compliance risk management, risk assessment, GRC reporting, regulatory compliance, and the ongoing effectiveness of the Consumer Compliance Management System (CMS).

Responsibilities

  • Source, compile, convert, organize and transfer data from various sources and advise Department on data design, extraction and interpretation in support of Department’s execution of associated Compliance Management programs.
  • Develop, maintain, and analyze key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and compliance metrics used to monitor consumer compliance risk across products, services, channels, and third-party relationships.
  • Analyze trends, identify patterns, and develop data-driven recommendations to improve compliance outcomes.
  • Identify, develop, document and deliver data analysis by importing, transforming, cleansing, validating data files, etc. and applying knowledge of other critical requirements as appropriate. Design, create and maintain consumer compliance dashboards and reporting, supporting Compliance Monitoring and Testing, Complaints, Issue Management, Regulatory Change Management, CRA, Fair Lending, UDAAP and other data related to compliance programs.
  • Support the Consumer Compliance Monitoring and Testing and Risk Assessment functions by providing validated data populations, exception reporting, trend analysis, and other tracking metrics.
  • Determine the optimal mode of delivery based on requesting party’s need, i.e. custom reports, Power BI, dashboards/visualization, graphs, tables, tabular reports, etc.
  • Collaborate with IT data team, other members of the Compliance Department, and data analysts throughout the organization to understand data structure, methodology and tools, gain appropriate access to required data, and issue resolution and provide technical expertise regarding compliance data and reporting outputs.
  • Ensure that appropriate validation and controls are built into data related processes to ensure that compliance data integrity is maintained. Lead and perform this effort with other team members as appropriate to ensure consistency and documentation of validation efforts for each project.
  • Coordinate efforts with third party vendors as well as Lines of Businesses for identifying, changing, mapping, and testing data files and fields. Work with applicable business functions to ensure accurate data models and reporting output.
  • Provide comprehensive operational, analytical, and technical support for projects that impact the corporate use of technology by advocating for the use of technology and reporting within the department to improve processes, controls, and reporting. Make recommendations to department management regarding projects as a technical resource during system enhancement reviews, consolidations/acquisitions, and other projects as needed.
  • Regularly monitor data to identify changes needed and develop recommendations for leadership consideration while drawing attention to trends observed and data anomalies. Enhance existing processes and reporting and analysis through automation, ongoing presentations and visualization enhancements, and conversations with key stakeholders.
  • Represent the Department in meetings, focus groups, projects, etc. regarding data and reporting that is needed, used or produced by the Department. Provide insight and guidance regarding Department’s data sourcing, structure and usage to ensure stakeholders’ understanding of the data output.
  • Serve as the data advocate for the Department to ensure needs are being met.
  • Promote the use of data analytics and related tools to internal staff, identify and communicate opportunities for technology-based enhancements, stay abreast of current and emerging industry and technology trends and the regulatory landscape.

Additional Responsibilities

  • May serve as back-up administrator for Department-related tools and platforms.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's Degree or the equivalent experience. Specialty: data analytics, data science, computer science. (Preferred)

Experience

5 or more years data analysis, report development and familiarity with banking-related systems/databases in support of Audit or Compliance Testing. (Required)

5 or more years banking operations, compliance operations, banking/compliance systems reporting/data management or data analysis experience. (Preferred)

Strong experience with business intelligence tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or similar tools (Required)

Certifications

CRCM or other relevant certification/credentials. (Preferred)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to maintain a growth mindset and adjust effectively to change (Required)
  • Ability to convey verbal and/or written information and ideas clearly, concisely and professionally to individuals or groups (Required)
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others in order to achieve common goals both internally and with external departments (Required)
  • Proficiency in mathematics, statistics, data analytics, data visualization (Preferred)
  • Strong analytical and technology skills with tools such as Excel, SharePoint or One Drive (Preferred)
  • Experience with Python, Java, SQL ACL or other programming language (Preferred)

Other Duties as Assigned by Manager

This role may perform other job duties as assigned by the manager. Each employee of the Organization, regardless of position, is accountable for reading, understanding and acting on the contents of all Company-assigned and/or job related Compliance Programs, regulations and policies and procedures, as well as ensure that all Compliance Training assignments are completed by established due dates. This includes but is not limited to, understanding and identifying compliance risks impacting their department(s), ensuring compliance with applicable laws or regulations, and escalating compliance risks to the appropriate level of management.

Pay Transparency

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges on all job postings regardless of state. We set standard salary ranges for our roles based on the position, function, and responsibilities, as benchmarked against similarly sized companies in our industry. Specific compensation offered will be determined based on a combination of factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. The salary range may vary based on geographic location.

The salary range for this position is $72,500.00 - $120,800.00 annually.

Additional Compensation Components

This job is eligible to participate in a short-term incentive compensation plan subject to individual and company performance.

Benefits

This includes medical plans with prescription drug coverage; flexible spending account or health savings account depending on the medical plan chosen; dental and vision insurance; life insurance; 401(k) program with employer match and Employee Stock Purchase Plan; paid time off programs including holiday pay and paid volunteer time; disability insurance coverage and maternity and parental leave; adoption assistance; educational assistance and a robust wellness program with financial incentives. To learn more about your potential eligibility for these programs, please visit Benefits & Wellness | Fulton Bank.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About India Market Entry (IME):

India Market Entry (IME) is a boutique market-entry consultancy helping international education companies establish and scale in India. Headquartered in Faridabad, we operate across 9 Indian cities with a 68-member team, 35+ global education clients, and a 150+ reseller network. Our clients include Save My Exams, Express Publishing, World Book, Hamilton House, Mathspace, EdAlive, and more.We are expanding our marketing team with new and Lead-generation Specialist (LGS) roles focused on driving high-quality lead qualification and sales conversions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Indian D2C education is large, fragmented, and unit-economics-fragile. Many D2C brands hit the same wall around Series A — CAC too high, retention choppy, next growth chapter requires institutional channel or bundling. That inflection point is your hunting ground. You speak with founders, growth heads, and BD heads at Indian D2C edtechs (subscription apps, parent-tutor marketplaces, AI-tutor brands), plus partnership heads at banks, NBFCs, and telcos exploring education bundles. You qualify their B2B-readiness, identify the right IME engagement pathway (Research / Decide / Validate / Scale) or portfolio fit, and hand off to the LSM team. These are peer conversations with founders — not vendor pitches.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the canonical Indian D2C education master list (~250 brands) plus the bank/NBFC/telco partnership list (~50 counterparties).

  • Run multi-touch outbound sequences (LinkedIn + email primary, WhatsApp once warm) to founders, growth heads, and BD heads.

  • Reach 50–80 founder / growth-head conversations per month.

  • Apply the D2C-variant of the qualifying questionnaire — D2C unit economics, B2B intent, channel readiness, product portability into school/edupreneur context.

  • Identify D2C brands at the 'B2B pivot' inflection point — these are highest-conversion prospects.

  • Recommend an engagement pathway per qualified prospect — IME Research, Decide, Validate, or Scale, or portfolio-fit partnership.

  • Track and act on funding signals — every Series A announcement in Indian edtech is a 7-day follow-up window.

  • Coordinate event-driven follow-ups around YourStory TechSparks, EdTech Review summits, NASSCOM Product Conclave.


Requirements

Skills Required:

  • 3–5 years of B2B inside sales / BD with D2C, consumer-tech, or startup exposure.

  • Comfort speaking with Indian D2C founders in peer register — this is not a vendor pitch.

  • Working knowledge of the Indian D2C education landscape and the D2C unit-economics vocabulary (CAC, LTV, payback, churn, MAU, DAU).

  • Strong written-English skills for LinkedIn DMs and founder-style emails.

  • Pattern-recognition for pivot-point signals — funding + hiring + product-pivot together signals readiness.

  • Prior experience inside an Indian D2C edtech or consumer-tech startup.

  • Awareness of recent Indian edtech funding, M&A, and down-round activity.

  • Working familiarity with the IME 4-tier productised architecture (IME Research / Decide / Validate / Scale).

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of approximately 20 to 30 large enterprise employer relationships. You will proactively surface renewal blockers, manage retention and renewals, and help benefits leaders and their advisors connect member access, engagement, outcomes, and financial value to clear decisions.

This role is for someone who can move from executive strategy to operating detail. You will diagnose what is blocking customer value, involve the right partners across Sword, and maintain a credible customer plan even when the process or internal owner is unclear.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build proactive account and renewal plans, identify risk early, and focus high-touch engagement where it can materially change the outcome.
  • Own retention strategy, pricing and contracting coordination, executive relationships, and risk plans across a portfolio of consequential enterprise accounts.
  • Build multithreaded relationships with benefits leaders, consultants, finance, clinical, procurement, and operational stakeholders, adapting the value story to each decision-maker.

  • Identify cross-functional breakdowns, engage the right partners across Sales, Growth Marketing, Implementation, Product, Clinical, Analytics, Finance, and Operations, and keep the customer informed through resolution.

What you need to have

  • Significant experience personally owning complex enterprise customer or client relationships after implementation, including renewals, retention, and account recovery.
  • Evidence of using quantitative customer-value data to make decisions and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication and the judgment to navigate competing customer, consultant, and internal priorities.
  • A record of identifying cross-functional breakdowns and engaging the right teams to execute a solution.
  • Comfort operating in a remote, fast-moving environment where priorities change and a process or owner may not yet be defined, while managing multiple consequential accounts and traveling up to 15%.

What we'd love to see

  • Direct work with enrollment, utilization, claims, outcomes, ROI, billing, or member-engagement data.
  • Experience managing complex portfolios through multiple renewal cycles and organizational change.

How success will be measured

In your first year, you will establish proactive renewal and retention plans, surface blockers earlier, expand access to eligible members where access is limiting results, and build executive and consultant relationships that increase confidence in Sword's value.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics leads the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continuous improvement of Relation’s enterprise data engineering and analytics capabilities. The individual in this role owns the data platform and analytics function end to end, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and trusted data solutions that support business priorities and measurable outcomes. The Director provides hands-on technical leadership, advances the responsible use of automation and proprietary AI, and leads and develops data engineering and analytics professionals.

The Director partners with executive, business, and technology leaders to translate priorities into a practical data roadmap and drive execution. The individual in this role establishes standards for data architecture, integration, quality, governance, security, reporting, and analytics while remaining sufficiently hands-on to guide complex technical work, resolve issues, and clearly communicate data, tradeoffs, and risk to non-technical stakeholders.

A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR DAY

Ownership and Accountability

  • Owns Relation’s data engineering and analytics function end to end, with full responsibility and accountability for execution and outcomes.
  • Translates business priorities, as set by executive and business leadership, into the data and analytics roadmap, sequences the work within those priorities, and drives it to completion, owning the outcome regardless of team size.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact and accountable authority for executives, business leaders, auditors, and carrier partners on data, reporting, and analytics matters.

Job Description:

Fortrea has an exciting opportunity for a Human Resources Specialist to join the HR Service Delivery Team! The Human Resources Specialist will act as a key contributor within the HR Service Delivery Team and is responsible for delivering superior customer service and providing quality and timely information to the people of the business regarding their general HR inquiries.

This is a great opportunity to join a fast paced, fun, collaborative Human Resources team with the ability to be remote!


Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a central point of contact for employees and leaders for HR-related inquiries received through the HR Case Management System, ensuring accurate and timely resolution.
  • Provide superior customer service when responding to employee and manager questions regarding payroll, benefits, leave of absence, company policies, Workday transactions, and other general HR inquiries.
  • Process and support employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, including hires, job changes, personal information changes, terminations, and other employee data updates, as applicable.
  • Review Workday transactions and employee data for accuracy and completeness, identifying and resolving data discrepancies or escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Complete Form I-9 documentation and associated new-hire activities using Workday, ensuring required documentation is completed accurately and timely.
  • Support new-hire and onboarding processes in Workday, including monitoring outstanding tasks and assisting employees and managers with Workday-related questions.
  • Facilitate employee offboarding activities, including processing and/or validating Workday termination transactions, termination documentation, final pay coordination, and separation information.
  • Assist employees and managers with Pay, Benefits, Time Off, and Leave of Absence inquiries, including navigating Workday and understanding applicable processes.
  • Monitor Workday inbox tasks and business processes assigned to HR Service Delivery and take appropriate action to ensure transactions are completed within established service-level expectations.
  • Run, review, and analyze Workday reports to support employee inquiries, HR operational processes, audits, data validation, and business needs; identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections as appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot basic Workday questions and transaction issues, providing guidance to employees and managers and escalating system or configuration issues to the appropriate HRIS/Workday team.
  • Perform employment verifications and provide employee documentation consistent with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and documentation within Workday and other HR systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Workday processes, HR knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, and employee self-service guidance based on recurring employee and manager questions.
  • Participate in Workday testing, process improvements, system enhancements, data validation, and HR Service Delivery projects, as needed.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, Leave, Talent Acquisition, HRIS/Workday, and other HR teams to resolve employee issues and ensure accurate HR data and processes.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant HR experience will be considered.
  • 2+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or HR Service Delivery preferred.
  • Experience in benefits, leave of absence, onboarding, offboarding, employment verification, and employee records.
  • Knowledge of Form I-9 and employment eligibility verification processes preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to research and resolve HR and Workday-related questions independently, while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, confidentiality, and proper handling of sensitive employee information.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests, manage competing deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced HR Service Delivery environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with HR Service Delivery, Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and other internal teams.
  • Ability to adapt to new HR systems, processes, policies, and technology and contribute to continuous process improvement.
  • Ability to participate in Workday testing, data validation, process improvement initiatives, and HR projects as needed.
  • Must have a dedicated and professional home working space that supports productivity and allows confidential employee and company information to be handled securely and privately.
  • Must have reliable high-speed internet connectivity and the ability to work effectively in a virtual environment, including participation in video meetings, calls, and other online collaboration activities.
  • Ability to maintain established working hours and availability consistent with business and HR Service Delivery needs.working with Workday or a comparable Human Resources Information System (HRIS) strongly preferred. Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to provide professional, timely, and accurate support to employees and leaders.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish, with strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate HR information, policies, processes, and guidance to employees and managers.
  • Working knowledge of Workday employee lifecycle processes, including payroll inquiries, employee data changes, reporting, terminations, and other HR business processes preferred.
  • Experience researching employee information, running reports, reviewing transactions, and maintaining accurate employee data within Workday or another HRIS.
  • Experience using an HR case management or ticketing system and managing inquiries through resolution preferred.
  • General knowledge of HR practices and processes, including payroll.

Please submit CVs in English language.

Are You Ready to Recruit Top Talent in One of the Fastest-Growing Industries?

Are you passionate about connecting exceptional sales professionals with career-changing opportunities? Do you have experience recruiting within Payroll, HCM, Payments, Merchant Services, PEO, or SaaS industries?

At Paynada, we're not just growing, we're transforming the way businesses manage payments and financial solutions. As we continue our rapid expansion, we're looking for a driven Talent Acquisition Specialist who thrives on identifying, engaging, and hiring top-performing talent from the Payroll, HCM, Payments, and FinTech sectors.

If you're energized by building world-class sales teams and want to make a direct impact on a high-growth organization, we'd love to meet you.

Role

The Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) is responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent across our organization, with a primary focus on sales and revenue-generating roles within the Payroll, HCM, Merchant Services, Payments, and FinTech industries.

This individual will leverage traditional recruiting methods, creative sourcing strategies, networking, and industry expertise to identify and engage top performers nationwide. The ideal candidate is a proactive recruiter who understands competitive talent markets, builds strong candidate pipelines, and serves as a trusted partner to hiring leaders.

This is a fully remote, home-based position that requires phone and video interviewing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively source passive candidates from Payroll, HCM, PEO, Payments, Merchant Services, FinTech, and related industries
  • Utilize LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, industry groups, and other sourcing tools to identify top talent
  • Build and maintain robust pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs
  • Develop innovative sourcing strategies to stay ahead in highly competitive talent markets
  • Conduct candidate screenings to evaluate skills, experience, cultural alignment, and career motivations
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities and talent requirements
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through offer acceptance
  • Serve as a brand ambassador for Paynada and effectively communicate our value proposition to prospective candidates
  • Stay informed on industry hiring trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor talent strategies
  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within ADP Workforce Now and other recruiting platforms
  • Consistently meet or exceed recruiting performance goals and hiring targets
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

Qualifications & Experience

  • 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within Payroll, HCM, PEO, Merchant Services, Payments, FinTech, or B2B sales environments
  • Proven success sourcing and recruiting outside sales professionals, account executives, business consultants, and other revenue-generating roles
  • Strong understanding of Payroll, HCM, Merchant Services, Payment Processing, or related industries
  • Demonstrated ability to build candidate pipelines and fill positions in competitive markets
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other modern sourcing tools

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions and priorities in a remote environment
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Experience with ATS platforms, preferably ADP Workforce Now
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related recruiting technologies
  • Reliable home internet connection and dedicated workspace

Why Join Paynada?

  • Competitive base salary: $60,000 - $70,000 annually
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Principal SAP EWM Architect
jobs.excerpt: About Open Sky GroupOpen Sky Group is an expert supply chain technology company.
jobs.description:
About Open Sky Group

Open Sky Group is an expert supply chain technology company. We have a cooperative and flexible working environment with excellent growth opportunities. We believe in giving employees the right tools to do the job and take that commitment very seriously. We offer competitive salaries and benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability Insurance. We also provide incentive compensation, a retirement savings plan with matching contributions, a comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a range of voluntary benefits including Accident and Critical Illness coverage.

About the role

Remote role, anywhere in the U.S.

As the Principal SAP EWM Architect (Extended Warehouse Management) for Open Sky Group’s Professional Services team, you will lead solution architecture and guide delivery across client engagements. You will translate warehouse operational needs into scalable SAP EWM solutions, advise clients, and provide functional and technical guidance to consultants. This role emphasizes architecture and process design, supported by selective hands-on configuration and complex issue resolution. You will also support presales, interview candidates, mentor consultants, and help practice leadership build SAP capabilities and service offerings.

Immediate Requirements

  • Support presales through client discovery, solution demonstrations, RFP responses, proofs of concept, scope definition, effort estimates, and statements of work.
  • Participate in candidate interviews, assess SAP EWM architecture, functional, and technical capabilities, and provide hiring recommendations to practice leadership.
  • Develop solution roadmaps, implementation approaches, and cost estimates aligned with client operations and business objectives.
  • Own SAP EWM solution architecture across discovery, design, configuration, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Provide expert guidance on solution design, configuration, integration, and deployment; perform targeted configuration and troubleshooting to validate designs and resolve critical issues.
  • Evaluate EWM deployment options and guide integration with ERP, transportation, production, quality, and warehouse automation systems.
  • Lead client engagements and strengthen delivery capabilities through the following activities:
    • Lead workshops to assess warehouse operations and translate business needs into scalable SAP EWM solutions.
    • Define future-state processes across inbound, outbound, inventory, replenishment, and production supply.
    • Guide clients through process changes, solution tradeoffs, and implementation priorities.
    • Establish design standards and review functional specifications, integration designs, and development requirements.
    • Serve as a senior advisor to client stakeholders and an escalation point for complex solution decisions.
    • Standardize delivery methods, documentation, and quality reviews; build reusable solution assets and implementation templates.
    • Guide functional consultants, developers, and integration specialists through configuration and technical execution.
    • Communicate architecture decisions, delivery risks, dependencies, and scope changes to client and internal teams.
    • Partner with project managers on resource planning, delivery readiness, and issue resolution.
  • Support practice leadership in developing service offerings, proposals, client expansion opportunities, and SAP EWM capabilities.
  • Support industry events, marketing content, and partner engagement in collaboration with practice leadership.
  • Mentor consultants and support onboarding, knowledge sharing, and professional development.

Ongoing Practice Contributions

  • Mentor consultants, share solution knowledge, and support onboarding and technical skills development.
  • Provide input on project staffing, skills needs, and certification priorities as the practice grows.
  • Develop reusable solution assets, delivery standards, and presales content in collaboration with practice leadership.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of SAP EWM experience, including multiple end-to-end implementations and demonstrated leadership of solution architecture or overall solution design.
  • Strong SAP EWM functional and configuration knowledge, with the ability to evaluate technical designs and guide developers and integration teams.
  • Proven experience leading client workshops, design decisions, and delivery teams; experience mentoring consultants and supporting team development.
  • Strong understanding of embedded and decentralized EWM, process integration, data migration, testing, and cutover. SAP S/4HANA transformation and legacy SAP WM migration experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting presales, scope definition, and estimates. Experience interviewing candidates, mentoring consultants, or developing consulting delivery methods preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. SAP EWM certification and experience with RF, warehouse automation, or EWM labor management preferred.

Additional Skills, Abilities, and Attributes

  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong workshop facilitation, presentation, and client relationship skills.
  • Ability to guide distributed delivery teams, provide constructive mentoring, and collaborate across sales and delivery.
  • Sound judgment in balancing client requirements, solution quality, and delivery commitments.

Work Location and Travel

  • Must be authorized to work in the US. Can live anywhere in the US.
  • This is a home-based, full-time, exempt role.
  • This position requires travel up to 70% by airplane and/or car, with overnights.

Physical Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Regularly required to talk and hear.
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to , handle, or feel, and reach with hands and arms.
  • This position requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, or pull office products and supplies, up to 40 pounds.

Benefits
Open Sky Group offers benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability Insurance, a retirement savings plan with company contribution, as well as a flexible and fun work environment.

Annual salary range: $150,000-$170,000.

The salary range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual salary will be commensurate with skills, experience, certifications or licenses, and other relevant factors.
