jobs.description:
Senior Director, Reach Operations and Events

College Board - Engagement and Reach (EaR)


Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near College Board offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All College Board employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position.


*Strong candidate already identified for this role


About the Team

The Engagement and Reach (EaR) team — roughly ninety professionals across Reach, Communications, and Counselor Community Engagement — drives College Board's strategy for reaching, engaging, and converting prospective students, families, and partners into the organization's programs. This role sits within Reach, which is responsible for connecting College Board with more students, families, and communities than ever before. That includes the work you'd expect from marketing — building interest in College Board's programs and services, and helping teams engage state and district leaders — but it also means thinking in new ways about audience engagement, including working through associations and other outside organizations to reach people College Board could not reach on its own.


About the Opportunity

This is a newly created role responsible for building, from the ground up, two enterprise-level systems that do not yet exist at College Board: a standardized approach to how the organization defines, scores, routes, and converts marketing leads, and a framework for how the organization prioritizes, resources, and measures impact across its full portfolio of over three hundred annual industry events and sponsorships. This role also builds the documentation and training infrastructure that drives adoption of these systems and establishes marketing as a cross-functional data and process partner across the organization, rather than a reactive service function.

This role will work through significant ambiguity, set direction for teams across State and District Partnerships (SDP), Global Programs and External Relations (GPER), Higher Education Membership and Access (HMA), and Program, and serve as a trusted point of view for senior leadership on questions of field marketing strategy, lead operations, event investment, and organization-wide measurement standards. This is an individual contributor role within Engagement and Reach (Reach), reporting to the Executive Director, Reach Operations, with the expectation that this person will design both systems and execute within them during this foundational period, building the supporting documentation and training that drive adoption, and refining the standards as the function matures.

In this role, you will:


Own the Enterprise Marketing Lead Operations System (35%)

  • Define and own the enterprise standard for what constitutes a qualified marketing lead and contact, including scoring methodology, routing logic, and conversion tracking
  • Architect the operating system connecting lead capture, scoring, and routing to sales pipeline outcomes — designed to be adopted across marketing, sales, and partner functions, not run manually
  • Continuously test, refine, and improve the lead and contact operations system as volume and complexity grow, treating this as a living standard rather than a one-time build
  • Build the reporting and analytics infrastructure that gives leadership visibility into lead velocity, conversion, and pipeline health

Own the Enterprise Event Strategy and Portfolio System (35%)

  • Define and own the enterprise-wide framework for how the organization evaluates, prioritizes, and resources its full portfolio of over three hundred annual industry events, sponsorships, and third-party engagements
  • Set the standards by which future events are selected, funded, and measured — building a system that other teams and future hires will operate within, not a calendar that this role runs alone
  • Establish the impact measurement model for event investment, including cost-per-lead, pipeline contribution, and return on investment (ROI), where no standardized model exists today
  • Lead negotiation and structuring of major sponsorships and speaking opportunities that carry enterprise-level visibility or investment

Shape Cross-Functional and Enterprise Direction (20%)

  • Serve as the trusted point of view for the Executive Director and VP of Reach on questions of field marketing strategy, lead operations, event investment, and organization-wide measurement standards brining a clear, defensible recommendation to every significant decision.
  • Align State and District Partnerships (SDP), Global Programs and External Relations (GPER), Program, and other functions to a shared standard for how the organization shows up externally and converts that presence into pipeline
  • Build and maintain centralized documentation and structured training on marketing measurement and CRM best practices, driving adoption across partner divisions and establishing marketing as a cross-functional data and process partner rather than a reactive service function
  • Anticipate second-order impacts of event and lead strategy decisions on sales forecasting, budget planning, and brand presence across the organization
  • Benchmark lead operations and event-portfolio practices against peer nonprofit and enterprise marketing organizations, bringing external models to bear rather than defaulting to internal legacy approaches

Execute Within the Systems You Build (10%)

  • Direct the build and initial operations of both systems during this foundational period, while the function is being stood up and before additional capacity is added
  • Identify, over time, where execution should transfer to future hires, agency partners, or a split of the combined role, and flag when scope has outgrown a single-person structure

About You

You have:

  • Seven or more years of experience across marketing operations, demand generation, or field/event marketing, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level systems or frameworks — not just execution within an existing one
  • A proven track record of building something from ambiguity: designing a process, system, or standard where none existed, rather than optimizing an established one
  • Deep proficiency with marketing automation platforms (for example, HubSpot or Marketo) and customer relationship management (CRM) systems (for example, Salesforce), including lead scoring, routing logic, and attribution modeling
  • Experience negotiating high-value sponsorships, partnerships, or vendor contracts with enterprise-level financial or reputational stakes
  • A demonstrated ability to set strategy and influence senior leaders — including Vice Presidents (VPs) and above — without relying on formal authority over the teams being aligned
  • Skilled at driving alignment across teams and functions that do not report to you — using data, credibility, and a clear point of view to move senior stakeholders toward a shared standard, rather than positional authority
  • Demonstrated track record of holding cross functional teams accountable to enterprise standards, and using data and adoption metrics without formal management responsibility over that team
  • Strong analytical skills, including building reporting and dashboards that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes
  • A track record of anticipating second-order impacts of decisions across functions, rather than optimizing for a single team's metrics
  • Degree requirement: Bachelor's degree required; equivalent professional experience will be considered in place of a degree
  • Ability to travel up to thirty percent of the time for on-site event execution and industry engagement
  • Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods; ability to travel to and navigate event venues and conference environments, including standing for extended periods during on-site event execution and occasionally lifting or transporting event materials (up to 25 pounds)

Preferred:

  • Experience standing up a net-new function or system within a growing organization, including navigating the ambiguity of building without a template
  • Experience operating at the intersection of marketing and sales, with a track record of improving lead-to-revenue conversion through system design rather than campaign tactics alone
  • A history of point of view being sought proactively by senior leadership on strategy, not just brought in to execute

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of five business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership, and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We're a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000–$160,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You'll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it's like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleAs Forward Deployed Staff - Engineering, you'll be embedded with client teams building production-grade AI systems.
jobs.description:
The Role

As Forward Deployed Staff - Engineering, you'll be embedded with client teams building production-grade AI systems. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design, build, and ship AI products and internal tools that solve real business problems.

The "Forward Deployed" Philosophy:

Everyone at LevelUp Labs is a generalist. You'll be expected to contribute across engineering, training, and content when needed. However, this role has a spike in engineering and implementation—you're someone who loves building production systems, debugging hard problems, and shipping code that works at scale.

What "spike" means: You can teach and create content, but your edge is in building. You're the person others go to when the system is broken, when the architecture needs rethinking, or when something needs to actually ship.

What You'll Do

Build

  • Design and implement production-grade AI systems alongside client engineering teams

  • Build LLM-powered applications: RAG systems, agents, evaluation frameworks, etc.

  • Own technical architecture decisions and trade-offs

  • Write code that's maintainable, tested, documented, and built to last

  • Debug complex issues across the stack

Embed

  • Work directly with client engineering teams as a peer, not an outside consultant

  • Understand client constraints, existing systems, and organizational context

  • Communicate progress and challenges to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Transfer knowledge to client teams—leave them better than you found them

Learn & Share

  • Distill learnings from implementations into patterns we can reuse

  • Contribute to our courses, documentation, and internal tooling

  • Stay current with AI developments—evaluate what actually works in production

  • Participate in technical discussions and code reviews

What We're Looking For

Must Have

Engineering

  • 2+ years building production software systems

  • Strong programming skills (Python required; experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or Rust a plus)

  • Deep experience with AI/ML systems: LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, evaluations

  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices (testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Production Mindset

  • You've shipped systems that handle real traffic and real users

  • You think about failure modes, edge cases, and operational concerns

  • You know the difference between demo code and production code

  • You've been paged at 2am and fixed something that was broken

Communication

  • Can explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders

  • Comfortable presenting architecture and progress to client leadership

  • Clear written communication (documentation, design docs, async updates)

  • Can work effectively with client teams across different cultures and timezones

Mindset

  • Self-directed—you don't need someone telling you what to do next

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements

  • Ego-free: you'll do whatever needs doing to ship

  • Strong opinions, loosely held

Nice to Have

  • Experience with enterprise clients (understanding their constraints and pace)

  • Prior consulting or client-facing engineering experience

  • Contributions to open source projects

  • Background with observability and evaluation frameworks for AI

  • Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers

What You'll Get

  • Competitive compensation (base + performance bonuses + outcome-based bonus per engagement)

  • Work on challenging problems with leading companies

  • Learn from a team with 30+ enterprise implementations and published AI research

  • Flexibility: remote-first, async-friendly

  • Direct impact: you're building real systems, not maintaining legacy code

  • Growth: as an early team member, you'll shape our engineering culture

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As an AI Deployment Strategist (Customer Outcome Leader) within Forward Deployment Engineering, you are the single-threaded business owner responsible for driving realized value, user adoption, and long-term expansion across our enterprise AI engagements.


Deploying enterprise AI is fundamentally different from traditional software delivery—it mutates operational workflows, alters decision-making rights, and spans multiple complex technical streams.


Working directly alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who build and optimize the technical architecture, you own the business realization.


You will bridge the gap between executive AI vision and day-to-day operational reality, ensuring our solutions deliver clear, measurable ROI while insulating technical teams from reactive firefighting and unmanaged scope creep.


Key Responsibilities

1. Single-Threaded Business & Value Ownership

  • Own end-to-end business success, ROI realization, and user adoption across high-impact enterprise accounts (e.g., global consultancies, Fortune 500 enterprises).
  • Establish baseline metrics, define target KPIs, and continuously measure, track, and present realized financial and operational value to client executives.
  • Serve as the primary peer and strategic advisor to client executive sponsors (CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, Business Unit Leads).

2. Multi-Stream Governance & Scope Control

  • Unite and govern complex, parallel workstreams (agent orchestration, guardrails/security, data pipelines, UI integration, and change management) under a single strategic roadmap.
  • Act as the strict gateway for engagement scope—eliminating unmanaged scope creep, managing client expectations, and translating ad-hoc requests into structured roadmap decisions.
  • Prevent technical teams from falling into reactive firefighting by maintaining clear operational boundaries and structured delivery cadences.

3. Workflow Redesign & Operational Change Management

  • Deeply analyze client operating models to identify high-value business problems and redesign operational workflows around AI capabilities.
  • Manage organizational change, address user inertia, and re-align decision rights to ensure end users actively adopt AI tools into daily workflows.
  • Conduct user feedback loops to refine the business solution, ensure outputs meet operational standards, and drive change management programs.

4. Partnership with Technical Delivery (FDEs)

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to translate business requirements into actionable technical user stories.
  • Protect engineering bandwidth by owning executive stakeholder management, business politics, and operational blockers, allowing FDEs to focus proactively on core technical architecture, evaluations, and system reliability.

5. Account Expansion & Value Scaling

  • Proactively identify adjacent, high-value enterprise use cases to expand account footprint post-initial deployment. • Turn successful proofs-of-concept (POCs) into multi-year, enterprise-wide production deployments.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain), forward-deployed engineering, technical account management, or forward-deployed strategic roles in high-growth B2B SaaS/AI companies.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise AI deployments, large language models (LLMs), multi-agent systems, and digital workflow transformation.
  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of aligning, advising, and holding accountability with C-suite executives and senior enterprise stakeholders.
  • Business Acumen: Demonstrated ability to construct business cases, model ROI, design KPIs, and re-engineer complex operational business processes.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to speak fluently with engineers, understand technical trade-offs (e.g., latency vs. accuracy, guardrail evaluation, data integration patterns), and translate technical complexity into business impact.
  • Change Management: Strong background in organizational design, user adoption, and driving behavioral change across large operational teams.

Core Competencies & Leadership Attributes

  • Single-Threaded Accountability: Takes complete ownership of business outcomes without deflecting to technical or operational complexity.
  • Scope Discipline: Firmly manages client expectations and resists unmanaged feature creep while maintaining high-trust executive relationships.
  • Strategic Clarity in Ambiguity: Able to bring order to fragmented, multi-stream AI initiatives and establish clear direction amidst rapid technological change.
  • Cross-Functional Catalyst: Bridges the cultural and operational gap between technical engineering teams and non-technical business leaders.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$112,900.00 - $182,600.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Fractured Atlas is seeking two full‐time Member Advisors - one Grants & Member Advisor and one Fundraising & Member Advisor. Fractured Atlas is a national, fully remote nonprofit arts service organization. Our work is guided by the belief that some of the boldest, most urgent creative work happens outside of institutions, led by individual artists, emerging collectives, and grassroots organizations. Our mission is to make the journey from inspiration to living practice more accessible and equitable for artists and creatives. We run the largest fiscal sponsorship program in the country, supporting thousands of active projects in every creative medium across all 50 states. Through fundraising tools, educational resources, visa letters, community programming, and 1-on-1 support, we help artists access the funding, time, and community they need to make the art the world needs.

A successful candidate in both roles will be a creative problem solver and quick learner who has an enthusiasm for the arts, is incredibly personable over the phone and email, possesses a high level of patience and understanding (particularly as it relates to explaining the same information multiple times), and is able to operate and respond in a fast-paced environment while remaining calm and collected. The Grants & Member Advisor will have expertise around supporting our fiscally sponsored projects through the grant process from application through reporting. The Fundraising & Member Advisor will have expertise around advising our fiscally sponsored projects on fundraising and donation processes, including individual appeals, crowdfunding, giving day campaigns, donation policies and processes, and donation investigation.

Candidates with a work history that includes grant writing, fundraising, development, and/or customer service will likely excel. Since Fractured Atlas works virtually, these positions require strong self-motivation and both will be remotely supervised by the Associate Director of Education & Engagement.

At Fractured Atlas, we individually and collectively work hard to carry out our organization’s mission. We also understand that work is just one part of life and, through a culture of care, support team members having full and robust lives outside of work. With that foundation, our organizational culture embraces people who are open to:

  • Building trust with others and addressing equitable distribution of responsibilities when collaborating.

This commitment is grounded in our belief that change is possible, and that our work and that of the artistic community as a whole will grow stronger as oppression is eliminated.

In our current phase of this journey towards being an Anti-Racist Anti-Oppressive organization, the whole staff is engaged in all staff ARAO meetings led by rotating teams and undergo training as part of their onboarding process. We recognize that we do not have all of the answers as we pursue this work. This work will continue to shift as the Fractured Atlas team changes. jobs.description:
Who we are: Yourgi is on a mission to become Earth's most trusted pet care connector, connecting pet parents with a reliable local network of certified professionals, pet resorts, and veterinary centers. Backed by a passionate team, our mission is to make pet care simple, accessible, and joyful for all. Because pets aren't just animals—they're family.

Yourgi's mission is to be pet parents' most trusted source for pet care services. We are building a differentiated experience for both pet parents and pros through our marketplace and software platform. Pet parents book grooming, boarding, daycare, and training, and independent pet-care pros run their businesses with Yourgi Pro, Connect, and Match. We also power booking for Destination Pet's own locations.

You'll build Yourgi's engineering services function from the ground up: DevOps, SRE, release engineering, infrastructure as code, data pipelines, security operations, and data governance. Your job is to make deploys boring, rollbacks instant, production visible, and data trustworthy. You'll lead a small team of DevOps and SRE engineers, some nearshore, stay hands-on, and set the operating practices every product team follows.

LOCATION : Remote (US only; must be authorized to work in the US, no visa sponsorship)

REPORTS TO: VP of Engineering

PAY: $190,000 base +10% bonus

CORE RESPONSIBILITES:

  • DevOps and release engineering: own CI/CD for API, web, and mobile (GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines), with unattended deploys, staged or canary releases, one-click rollback, and controlled production deploy access.
  • SRE: stand up production monitoring and alerting on AWS (CloudWatch, X-Ray, synthetics, and PagerDuty), define SLOs for critical customer journeys, and replace noisy alert channels with alerts that are actionable and owned.
  • Incident and change management: launch a shared on-call rotation, incident response, blameless postmortems, and weekly operational reviews.
  • Infrastructure as code: bring AWS infrastructure and database operations under code (OpenTofu, Terraform, or CDK), with consistent environments and reviewed changes.
  • Data pipelines: own the reliability of pipelines that move data from our services and partner systems into the data lake and warehouse, with monitoring, retries, and clear owners.
  • Security operations: run secrets management, least-privilege IAM, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and supply-chain hygiene in every pipeline.
  • Data governance: set standards for data access, retention, classification, and logging so customer data is handled safely across systems.
  • Measures and cost: report DORA metrics (deploy frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore) and make cloud cost visible by team and service.
  • People: hire, manage, and develop DevOps and SRE engineers, and help product teams own their services in production.

30/60/90 plan


First 30 Days: Inventory the existing pipelines, environments, AWS accounts, alerts, data pipelines, and production access permissions. Establish baseline monitoring for the most critical services. By the end of the first 30 days, review the current-state inventory and the key operational and security risks with the VP of Engineering, and ensure that baseline monitoring dashboards are live.


By Day 60: Establish and launch the on-call rotation and incident management process. Deliver at least one pipeline with automated deployment and rollback capabilities. Publish the initial standards for secrets management, access controls, and data handling. By day 60, ensure the on-call rotation is staffed, the first incident postmortems are documented, weekly operational dashboards are being reported, and the standards have been approved.


By Day 90: Define service-level objectives (SLOs) and configure alerts for the five most important customer journeys. Transition most production services into a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. Introduce a monthly report covering DORA metrics and cloud costs. By the end of 90 days, ensure that SLOs and paging alerts are operational for all five customer journeys, deliver the first DORA and cloud-cost report to leadership, and establish an agreed-upon team hiring plan.

What will you need?

Required skills and experience

  • 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers.
  • Deep AWS experience, especially serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, and API Gateway), IAM, and RDS.
  • Built CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, or similar, including automated rollback.
  • Infrastructure as code in production (Terraform, OpenTofu, or CDK).
  • Ran on-call and incident management that measurably reduced incidents and time to restore.
  • Hands-on security operations: secrets management, access control, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Comfortable managing nearshore or distributed team members.

Differentiators

  • Data pipeline and data governance experience (e.g., Snowflake, data lakes, or event pipelines).
  • Datadog or CloudWatch at scale; OpenTelemetry.
  • Mobile release pipelines (App Store and Google Play).
  • PCI awareness from working with payments (Stripe).
  • AI tools for operations, such as incident summarization and runbook automation.

PERKS:

  • Health, vision, dental, long & short-term disability, and Life insurance
  • A Startup mentality company with stable funding
  • 401k match
  • Pet Care discounts
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Opportunity to grow your career with a network of like-minded professionals

jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

Sword Health is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our marketing team and lead the creation of the marketing materials that speak directly to our members. You will own how Sword shows up in front of members across our products and a wide mix of acquisition channels, including email, direct mail, toolkits, landing pages, and paid media. This role sits at the center of a cross-functional group of designers, clinicians, copywriters, and marketing operations partners, and is responsible for turning a deep understanding of member needs into content that drives engagement and enrollment. We are looking for a creative, data-driven, and member-centric marketer who can manage multiple channels at once, move quickly, and keep improving results over time.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the end-to-end creation of marketing materials for Sword Health members across our products and channels, including email, direct mailers, toolkits, paid media, and more
  • Translate member insights, needs, and motivations into clear, compelling messaging and creative concepts tailored to each product and population
  • Partner closely with design, clinical, copywriting, customer success, and marketing operations teams to brief, develop, review, and launch materials on time and to Sword’s quality and compliance standards
  • Own the planning and execution of campaigns and assets across channels, ensuring a consistent, best-in-class member experience
  • Analyze the main performance metrics of each channel (e.g., open and click rates, enrollment conversion, CPA, and engagement) and turn the findings into clear recommendations
  • Design and run tests (messaging, creative, audiences, formats) and apply the learnings to continuously improve performance
  • Work with clinical partners to make sure content is accurate, empathetic, and aligned with Sword’s clinical approach
  • Work with marketing operations on audience segmentation, targeting, and campaign deployment
  • Report on campaign and channel performance to internal stakeholders, and surface learnings that can scale across products and channels
  • Stay close to the member voice by using feedback, research, and data to shape future content and strategy

What you need to have

  • 3–5 years of experience in a marketing role, ideally in B2C, lifecycle, or growth marketing; digital health or B2B2C experience is a plus (but not required)
  • Experience creating and managing marketing materials across multiple channels (e.g., email, direct mail, paid media, and/or toolkits)
  • Ability to understand member needs and translate them into effective messaging and creative
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple initiatives at once
  • Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to read channel performance metrics, draw insights, and act on them
  • Experience working cross-functionally with design, copy, clinical, and/or operations teams to deliver projects on tight timelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A member-centric and growth mindset, with the ability to empathize with our patients and their challenges
  • Creative and strategic thinking, with a willingness to test new ideas and push boundaries
  • Collaborative with team members within and across US and international locations
  • Experience and desire to work in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

What we would love to see (Optional)

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated industries (e.g., familiarity with HIPAA and compliant member communications)
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation or CRM platforms and with paid media platforms
  • Experience with A/B and multivariate testing and a data-driven approach to optimization
  • Experience working with B2B2C models, where you market to end users on behalf of client organizations

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
€36.138—€56.788 EUR
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.

This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's.   • Analyze member behavior, drop-off points, and engagement patterns to identify opportunities for product improvement.

Director of Applied AI Engineering

North - Remote (US)


Let’s go North, together.


Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. This is a delivery role, not a research role, measured by systems that are live, adopted, and safe to run in a regulated financial services environment. This will require an individual with strong software engineering fundamentals, judgment about where large language models and machine learning outperform conventional automation, attention to detail, and the capacity to rapidly develop and act upon in-depth knowledge of our business, products, customers, and regulatory obligations.


This position will partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Risk to improve current business processes, and will work with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security to ensure AI systems are explainable, auditable, and safely governed. This role is responsible for providing updates to leadership on the team's impact through clear reporting and KPIs, and for establishing the long-term strategy, technical architecture, and responsible-AI guardrails as well as the short-term scope and sequencing that gets value into production quickly.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build and lead a high-performing Applied AI engineering team, defining the practice's operating model, engagement strategy, and technical standards from the ground up.
  • Partner with Product, customers, and business stakeholders to observe workflows and turn operational challenges into effective AI solutions.
  • Drive rapid discovery, prototyping, and seamless transition of AI capabilities to production across concurrent enterprise projects.
  • Architect, deploy, and maintain production AI solutions, including agentic workflows, chatbots, copilots, agent-assist tools, and traditional ML models.
  • Establish modular, reusable integrations for AI agents to securely access internal systems and enterprise data with least-privilege controls.
  • Own the AI evaluation lifecycle, incorporating offline/online evals, benchmark datasets, human-in-the-loop validation, and production readiness criteria.
  • Manage production operations alongside Cloud and Data engineering, overseeing CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, latency, and inference cost optimization.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, or a related domain, including time in a customer-facing or business-embedded engineering capacity (ex. forward deployed, solutions, or professional services engineering)
  • 2+ years building and shipping production systems on top of large language models (LLMs), including at least one agentic or conversational system live with real users
  • 4+ years of hands-on management experience with a track record of hiring and growing teams as well as providing coaching and mentoring
  • Exceptional leadership skills, and proven ability to operate in a fast-moving environment
  • Hands-on approach to closing gaps in technical execution, able to personally debug a misbehaving agent in production

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and executive-level communication skills, bridging technical teams and leadership seamlessly.
  • Hands-on expertise in code-level AI SDKs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Strands Agents), selecting optimal tools rather than relying on no-code builders.
  • Knowledge of core building blocks of production AI applications: tool/function calling, RAG, vector search, structured outputs, conversation and state management, and the judgment to favor deterministic workflows when appropriate.
  • Cloud engineering skills (preferably AWS), including deploying agents on managed services (e.g., Bedrock AgentCore), containers, IAM, networking, and cost optimization.
  • Track record deploying and maintaining production AI systems, driving robust CI/CD, tracing, incident response, and latency/cost controls.
  • Experience making evaluation part of the build cycle, including test sets, regression testing, human review, and measuring quality once systems are live
  • Grasp of AI security and guardrails (prompt injection defense, least-privilege access, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop design) aligned with financial regulations (Model Risk Management, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA).

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Education Assistance
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Salary Range: $207,000-290,000 USD

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.


Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.

Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.


Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.

jobs.description:
Welcome to MICE DESK

﻿

MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry — and we are now expanding to the US.

Our platform, Rocket, turns event, meeting, and group inquiries into autonomous end-to- end workflows: from RFP to signed contract, across email, CRM, and PMS systems. We integrate with the systems hotels actually run on — Oracle OPERA Cloud, SIHOT, Guestline, Salesforce, Marriott's enterprise stack — which means our engineers work inside real hotel operations, not against sandbox APIs.

We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture.
﻿

﻿﻿

The Role

Product Owners are how Rocket turns product direction into successful execution. You own specific product domains within the platform, ensuring engineering teams have clear requirements, priorities, and context needed to deliver high-quality features.

This is not a strategy ownership role. You work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams to translate product direction into actionable requirements, manage delivery, and ensure successful execution within your product area.

If you enjoy solving complex product problems, coordinating teams, and turning ideas into reliable software experiences, this is the role.

What You Will Own

1. Backlog ownership and delivery execution.

Own delivery for assigned product domains across the MICE DESK platform. Manage and refine the backlog, prioritize work based on guidance from the Product Manager, customer input, and business impact, and ensure engineering teams have everything required to deliver successful features.

2. Requirements and feature definition.

Translate product direction and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications while ensuring features are well understood before development begins.

3. Cross-functional collaboration.

Act as the connection point between Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and customer-facing teams throughout the development lifecycle. Support alignment on scope, priorities, delivery expectations, and successful feature releases.

4. Customer and product understanding.

Build a strong working understanding of customer workflows and operational pain points within your product domain. Support customer feedback collection, help validate solutions in partnership with the Product Manager, and provide insights that improve product execution.

5. Continuous improvement.

Improve product delivery through structured feedback, better processes, and execution-level insights. Surface opportunities for product enhancements to inform product strategy, support product discovery and experimentation led by the Product Manager, and contribute insights to long-term product planning.

What Success Looks Like

  • 3 months: You understand your assigned product domains, work effectively with Engineering and Product, and independently manage requirements, backlog refinement, and delivery processes.
  • 12 months: You own delivery across key product areas, engineering teams rely on your clarity and execution, and your work consistently improves feature delivery quality and customer outcomes.

    ﻿

    ﻿

Who You Are

Must-have
﻿

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role in a SaaS or software product environment
  • Proven experience managing product backlogs and supporting software delivery
  • Strong ability to translate customer and product needs into clear requirements
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience using product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, or similar
  • Excellent English communication skills (B2–C1)
    ﻿
    ﻿

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with AI-powered or data-driven SaaS products
  • Experience in Hospitality Tech, CRM, PMS, or workflow automation platforms
  • Familiarity with UX principles and customer discovery techniques
  • Experience working with cross-functional, distributed teams
  • Exposure to analytics tools and product metrics
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

Hiring Process

  • Intro interview — background, product experience, delivery ownership, communication skills, and motivation for joining MICE DESK
  • Product & Delivery interview — backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, stakeholder collaboration, Agile delivery, and real-world product execution scenarios
  • Founder / Product Manager interview — product vision, ownership mindset, collaboration style, and your role in executing MICE DESK's product direction

Why MICE DESK

  • Own delivery for meaningful product domains in an AI-native SaaS platform
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and founders to execute product direction
  • Build solutions that solve real-world challenges for the hospitality industry
  • Join a fast-growing Series A startup where your delivery has immediate customer impact
  • Be part of a small, ambitious team building the future of AI-powered hospitality technology

HIRING PRACTICES

jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

Department: Patient Support Center – CareSync

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.


Who We Are

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.


The Role

The Patient Engagement Specialist is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.


This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion

  • Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
  • Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
  • Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
  • Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
  • Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

Process Referrals Accurately

  • Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
  • Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
  • Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
  • Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers

  • Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
  • Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
  • Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls

  • Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
  • Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

Grow Through Coaching & Quality

  • Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
  • Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
  • Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

Own the Patient & Provider Experience

  • Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
  • Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
  • Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

Who You Are

  • A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
  • Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
  • Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
  • A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
  • Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
  • Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
  • Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

What You Bring

  • 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
  • Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickly (preferred).
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining a warm, focused conversation with the patient.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

At Geode Health, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible schedule

  • In-person and virtual patient visits

  • Comprehensive admin support (front office, accounting, finance, payroll, HR, etc)

  • Professional development opportunities

  • Clinical community, support, and leadership

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Life insurance

  • Short and long-term disability

  • Paid vacation and holidays

  • Matching 401k plan

  • State of the art technology

Why work for Geode Health?

At Geode Health, we take our commitment to patients and providers seriously. We focus every day on how to help patients across the United States get the best possible mental health care available. To achieve this, we focus on ensuring our providers have unmatched support and resources so that they can focus on providing great care. We are backed by KKR, a leading private equity firm with the experience and mission alignment to truly make an impact. Joining Geode Health will put you on the front-end of a rapidly growing movement to increase access and improve outcomes for mental health patients and providers across the nation.

To learn more, visit us as

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

The National Account Manager, Market Access Employer Engagement, is a strategic, external-facing member of US Market Access. Reporting to the Director, Employer Engagement - Obesity, this role leads engagement with a defined portfolio of jumbo employers and the organizations that shape their health-benefit decisions, including employer benefit consultants, coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers, point-solution partners and, where relevant, IDNs. The Account Manager helps customers navigate evidence-based approaches to obesity and other Amgen therapeutic areas as assigned, with the goal of enabling appropriate patient access, sustainable benefit design and improved population-health outcomes.

This role combines consultative account leadership with deep market access expertise. The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Success is measured by the quality and strategic depth of customer engagement, access progress within priority accounts, actionable insight and cross-functional impact - not by traditional sales call activity alone.

Conduct field sales support as necessary to drive pull through of coverage opportunities and resolve billing and coding issues related to Amgen products

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is scaling its Comparison business, and we’re looking for a Digital Experience Lead to help drive its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on role focused on improving conversion across our landing pages and customer journeys.

Our Comparison business connects customers with the right products across a panel of partners, earning revenue by sending high-intent, well-matched customers their way. With significant investment across paid acquisition, getting the experience right from the moment a customer lands with us is critical.

You’ll work closely with SEM, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to understand customer behaviour, identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into experiments and improvements that drive measurable commercial impact.

The person we’re looking for is curious, commercially minded and obsessed with understanding what makes customers convert. You’ll be equally comfortable digging into performance data, developing a hypothesis, shaping a new experience and getting an experiment live.

Responsibilities:

Conversion & experimentation

  • Own the optimisation roadmap across your areas of the Comparison business, prioritising the biggest opportunities to improve conversion.
  • Continually optimise landing pages and customer journeys, using performance data and customer insight to identify and remove friction.
  • Turn opportunities into clear hypotheses and own experiments end-to-end – from test design and success measures through to execution, analysis and recommendations.
  • Balance quick wins with bigger ideas that could materially change performance, turning successful experiments into scalable improvements.

SEM & landing page performance

  • Work hand-in-hand with SEM to connect acquisition strategy with the on-site experience, maximising conversion and value from paid traffic.
  • Understand differences in customer intent, keywords, campaigns and traffic sources, and use those insights to shape landing page experiences.
  • Look across the full funnel to ensure optimisation drives meaningful commercial outcomes, not individual metrics in isolation.

Cross-functional delivery

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Design to identify opportunities and take experiments and experience improvements from idea through to launch.
  • Work with Data to ensure the right tracking and measurement are in place to make confident decisions.
  • Clearly communicate results, learnings and recommendations to stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years' experience in conversion rate optimisation, digital experience, growth or a similar optimisation-focused role.
  • Proven experience improving landing pages, funnels and digital customer journeys through experimentation.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing, from hypothesis development and test design through to analysis and decision-making.
  • Commercially sharp and able to connect customer behaviour and conversion to revenue and wider business performance.
  • Data-driven and curious, with the ability to spot opportunities and turn insight into action.
  • Strong understanding of UX and conversion best practices.
  • Experience with analytics and experimentation platforms such as GA4, Optimizely or similar.
  • A proactive self-starter, comfortable working across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Design and Data to get things done.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience optimising landing pages for SEM or other paid acquisition channels.
  • Experience within comparison, lead generation, affiliate or another performance-driven digital business in Home Improvement, Small Medium Business or similar.
  • Experience with user testing, session replay, heatmaps or other qualitative research methods.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Tableau or similar analytics tools.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to protect our people, data, and operations from modern threats, including those enabled by AI (Artificial Intelligence). You will serve as a technical authority on both sides of cybersecurity: defending against active threats, and designing and engineering cybersecurity into every layer of our technology environment. You will partner with IT, Legal, and business leaders to reduce risk across the enterprise.


How you will Own It:


Threat Defense

  • Lead investigation and containment of phishing, account compromise, and endpoint and network threats, correlating signals across endpoint, identity, email, and network data.
  • Monitor and triage alerts, and investigate anomalous identity and email activity, including suspicious sign-ins and business email compromise indicators.
  • Execute rapid response actions, such as disabling accounts, revoking sessions, and blocking indicators, and document root cause and remediation for leadership and auditors.
  • Develop and tune detections and response playbooks based on emerging threats, including AI-enabled attacks, and lessons learned from incidents.
  • Coordinate major incident response across IT, Legal, and external response partners, and strengthen readiness through tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.
  • Perform forensic evidence collection and support legal holds and eDiscovery in partnership with Legal.
  • Share in an on-call rotation providing escalation coverage.

Cybersecurity Engineering

  • Architect and engineer cybersecurity solutions across the full technology stack, including endpoints, networks, identity, email and collaboration, cloud, applications, data, AI systems, and infrastructure, from requirements and design through implementation and lifecycle management.
  • Apply secure-by-design principles such as least privilege, defense in depth, zero trust, and segmentation, using threat modeling and architecture reviews, and maintain cybersecurity standards, reference architectures, and hardened baselines that are monitored for drift.
  • Design and govern identity and access controls with identity and infrastructure teams, including conditional access, network restrictions, privileged-access processes, and non-human identities.
  • Secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure through configuration standards, posture management, and guardrails that scale across environments.
  • Automate and codify cybersecurity controls, deployments, and workflows to reduce manual effort, variance, and risk.
  • Validate and release controls through testing, staged rollouts, and change management, operate cybersecurity platforms for resilience, coverage, and telemetry quality, and evaluate and integrate new technologies through proofs of concept.
  • Drive vulnerability and exposure reduction with infrastructure, cloud, and application owners, prioritizing by business impact and fixing root causes rather than applying one-off patches.

Risk & Governance

  • Assess AI and software vendors for cybersecurity, data protection, and governance risk, and deliver decision-ready recommendations.
  • Provide technical evidence and input for audits, framework maturity reviews, cybersecurity standards, and penetration-test remediation.
  • Manage cybersecurity vendor relationships, including renewals, service retainers, and roadmap input.

What you’ll Bring:

  • 5–8+ years in cybersecurity engineering, cybersecurity operations, or incident response.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience engineering, securing, and administering enterprise technology (endpoints, networks, identity, cloud, email, and applications) and cybersecurity platforms, along with incident response experience.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS, or ISO 27001.
  • One or more certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or Security+.

You’re Good-to-Go if you have:


Sound judgment under pressure, clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, discretion with confidential matters, a collaborative approach to influencing without formal authority, and the curiosity to keep pace with emerging technology and threats.


Added Fuel if you have:


  • Experience securing AI systems, or familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Scripting, automation, and infrastructure-as-code skills (e.g., Python).
  • Cloud security experience across major cloud platforms.
  • Digital forensics and eDiscovery experience.
  • Threat hunting and third-party risk assessment experience.

How Success Is Measured

  • Threat defense: faster detection and response, and incidents closed with documented root cause.
  • Cybersecurity engineering: systems aligned to cybersecurity baselines, strong control coverage, timely remediation of critical vulnerabilities, and automation that reduces manual work and configuration drift.
  • Governance: strong audit outcomes and timely vendor risk decisions.

Our mission is to inspire hope through advancing mental wellness to cancer patients, their families and caregivers. We are looking for empathetic, experienced mental health professionals to come along side us in this endeavor!

This is a fully remote role.

Pay: $60-62/hr.

Role:

Through a respectful, constructive and energetic style, guided by the mission of the clinic, a therapist will seek to facilitate hope and change in the lives of their clients who have been affected by cancer. A therapist is responsible for accepting referrals and maintaining a client load (minimum 18 hours per week).

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Counsel clients or patients individually and/or within family sessions, to assist in overcoming dependencies, adjusting to life, or making changes.
  • Make internal referrals to IOP if little to no improvement occurs within 8 weeks of OP therapy.
  • Guide clients in the development of skills or strategies for dealing with their problems.
  • Develop and implement treatment plans based on clinical experience and knowledge, establishing SMART goals with the patient. Treatment plans are to be developed 72 hours after intake and updated / modified every 4 weeks.
  • Fill out and maintain client-related paperwork, including client diagnostic records and progress notes. Progress notes are to be developed 48 hours after every session.
  • Prepare and maintain all required treatment records and reports.
  • Evaluate clients' physical or mental condition, based on review of client information.
  • Collaborate with other staff members to perform clinical assessments or develop treatment plans within 2 days of establishing care with the existing patient.
  • Refer patients, clients, or family members to community resources or to specialists as necessary.
  • Learn about new developments in counseling by reading professional literature, attending courses and seminars, or establishing and maintaining contact with other social service agencies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Masters Degree from an accredited college or university
  • Two years of professional level experience in a counselor setting
  • Current and active Licensed Clinical Social Worker license in Texas

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience in healthcare with oncology
  • 1 year experience in Telehealth Settings
Salary: 60-62 DOE
